job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Are you ready to lead a high-impact vendor management organization? Are you energized by the challenge of building scaled solutions that drive profitable growth for tens of thousands of vendors across the world's largest e-commerce ecosystem?

Amazon is seeking a Director, Retail Business Services (RBS), Selling Partner Engagement & Growth (SPEG) Small and Medium Businesses (SMB) to serve as the single-threaded leader for end-to-end management of Torso/Tail vendors — driving profitable growth through two integrated programs: Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) - paid vendor management service, and Mass Vendor Relations (MVR) - non paid scaled vendor management.

This role presents a unique opportunity to lead a ~$20B+ GMS business across worldwide Amazon marketplaces, managing a team of ~2,000 HC and 10 direct reports spanning 10 countries. You will simultaneously manage paid (AVS) and non-paid (MVR) vendor channels with distinct P&L dynamics across 18 stores globally. The business demands active navigation of multi-dimensional headwinds — including complex vendor portfolio transitions, tariff-driven profitability erosion, vendor fraud detection, and evolving marketplace dynamics — all while sustaining strong productivity improvement.

The successful candidate will shape the future of how Amazon manages its Torso/Tail vendor ecosystem at scale, defining how we leverage technology, and operational excellence to drive vendor growth, improve profitability, and deliver best-in-class Selling Partner experience. This role offers unparalleled opportunity to build and scale programs that directly impact Amazon's bottom line while enhancing the experience of thousands of vendors worldwide.

Strategic Leadership & Vision
- Drive the north star vision of "no-unmanaged vendor" across WW Amazon marketplaces — building scaled, paid and non-paid vendor management solutions (AVS, VCP, MVR) that drive profitable growth for Torso/Tail vendors
- Establish and own the P&L for Torso/Tail vendors; build a shadow P&L and drive key input metrics (inventory, pricing, selection, deals) to drive business growth and profitability
- Define and execute the multi-year growth agenda — expanding Torso/Tail vendor coverage globally, scaling to new marketplaces, and reimagining delivery models

Program Management & Execution
- Build Best-in-Class AVS service — enabling vendor growth through Vendor Growth Plans (VGPs)
- Lead MVR growth engine — recruit and ramp new brands, reduce activation time, and drive FCF

Stakeholder Management & Influence
- Influence Retail Leaders (Country Managers, Finance, Category Leaders) across VP organizations to identify business priorities, develop joint goals, drive standardization, and jointly build the long-term strategic vision for program growth
- Lead vendor negotiation strategy — own annual vendor negotiations (AVN) and build always-on negotiation (AoN) capabilities targeting incremental FCF and CM improvement

- Champion GenAI automation to drive productivity improvement
- Build proactive detection mechanisms for vendor fraud and emerging risk MOs
- Drive Exceptional Vendor Experience (VX)— through internal and external benchmarking to understand key vendor pain points, and build the services, technologies, systems, and mechanisms to drive best-in-class VSAT

Leadership Impact
- Own the people charter — define the appropriate org structure, drive consistency in employee experience across 10 countries, drive diversity and inclusion initiatives that impact at scale
- Build mechanisms to audit employee and team performance, and cultivate a Day-1 culture of bold experimentation and GenAI upskilling
- Develop next-generation leaders across a globally distributed team
- Make bold, high-velocity decisions in areas where the operating model is actively being redefined

- Full time MBA or equivalent
- Minimum 10+ years in managing vendor relationships
- Experience managing P&L at scale across multiple geographies
- Hands-on experience in Retail, eCommerce, and supply chain functions
- Experience in complex cross-functional launches partnering with central teams

- Business Education (MBA) preferred
- Familiarity or experience with autonomous systems and machine learning is a plus for this role

- Demonstrated agility in thriving within fast-paced and innovative environments
- Experience in working with diverse set of team members, stakeholders, and customers

job_title: Applied Scientist II, Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS)
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Can a large language model read a regulatory change and draft the requirements and control tests that follow from it, accurately enough for a Compliance Officer to sign off? How do you train a breach-risk model when confirmed breaches are rare, arrive months after the event, and mean different things to Compliance, Assurance, and the regulator? What does a model have to prove before a Compliance team acts on its output?

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to join the Data and Analytics team within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS). Our team builds the data, analytics, and modeling layer that RCS runs on, from regulatory reports and filings to the intelligence that tells Compliance Officers and our first line of defense (1LoD) partners where risk concentrates and which controls hold. You build the machine learning (ML) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) systems in that layer, take them into production, and own the evaluation science that lets Compliance rely on them.

The work spans 3 areas: risk models that score which open risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches; GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage; and the evaluation science behind every model and agent the team ships. Financial crime compliance is the first domain, and its constraints shape the science: threats change faster than control sets adapt, and every output faces internal audit and external examination. Once an approach proves out, you carry it into the next compliance domain across the RCS portfolio.

You own problems from formulation to production: framing the science question with Compliance and 1LoD partners, designing experiments and backtests, building and validating models, and shipping them into the pipelines, reports, and tools that RCS teams use. The stack includes Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Lambda, and your partners include data scientists, data engineers, business intelligence engineers, and software development engineers across RCS.

The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement, writes production-quality code alongside their models, and stays comfortable when the evaluation set does not exist until they build it.

Key job responsibilities
• Formulate ambiguous compliance problems as ML and GenAI problems with Compliance and 1LoD partners, and choose methods that fit the data, the risk, and the audit standard
• Develop risk models that learn from rare, delayed, and noisy labels to score which risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches, and calibrate them so a score carries a defensible meaning
• Build GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage
• Design the evaluation for every ML and GenAI system you ship: golden sets that compliance experts label, metrics suited to rare outcomes and generated text, and release criteria a system meets before Compliance relies on it
• Deploy and monitor models in production with software development engineers, including drift detection, performance tracking against realized outcomes, and retraining criteria
• Explain model decisions, quantify uncertainty, and document methodology so Compliance Officers, auditors, and examiners can trace how a system reached each output
• Create reusable science components, such as feature sets, scoring services, and evaluation harnesses, so an approach that works in financial crime compliance extends to the next domain without a rebuild
• Review peer models for statistical soundness, mentor data scientists and engineers on ML methods and experimental design, and publish or patent where the work and confidentiality allow

About the team
Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. RCS operates as the second line of defense under the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model, providing specialized oversight, monitoring, and expertise while setting policies and procedures that guide Amazon's compliance framework.

RCS's mission is to apply specialist industry insights and Amazon's unique approach to scale through technology, delighting customers through tailored compliance solutions. Our work spans multiple critical areas, including:
• Streamlined license acquisition that enables Amazon's financial services expansion
• Management of existing business risks across the organization
• Comprehensive governance, risk, and assurance services
• Innovative solutions such as Compliance as a Service (CaaS)
• A proactive, intelligence-led framework for compliance operations

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience in financial modeling, or experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment
- Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations, or experience with data infrastructures: relational analytic DBMS, Elastic-Search, and Big Data EMR/EC2/Glue/Lambda

DESCRIPTION
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products and enterprise services. APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across Amazon’s transportation network. It ensures hassle-free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team (RCMT) within NOC is the centralized risk management function for RoW Surface Transportation. This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. Our overarching vision is to ensure that bad actors never derive any benefit from Amazon by exploiting our policies. To achieve this, RCMT relies on sound judgment, technical expertise, and a robust risk management framework. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations across RoW countries — Brazil, Mexico, AMET (Egypt, KSA, South Africa, UAE), Japan, India, and Australia.
The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational week-offs) to provide round-the-clock risk coverage across time zones.

Key job responsibilities
• Process Expertise & Subject Matter Leadership — Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of Surface Transportation processes and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for risk management within the assigned RoW geographies. Maintain subject matter expertise specific to job functions and general industry awareness to provide informed recommendations to leadership.
• Risk Mitigation & Process Improvement — Apply risk-management best practices and methodologies to mitigate identified risk issues. Execute against established SOPs, identify and recommend opportunities for process improvement, draft SOP revisions, and conduct risk assessments for new process implementations to ensure vulnerabilities are identified and mitigated before go-live.
• Team Management & Development — Manage and supervise investigators — including workload assignment, quality review of investigation outputs, SLA adherence monitoring, and calibration. Mentor new hires and participate in the development and delivery of risk management training.
• Trend Analysis & Financial Impact Quantification — Conduct weekly and monthly trend analysis across assigned RoW geographies, including period-over-period comparisons and concentration analysis. Own the financial impact quantification framework — tracking cost leakage, cost avoidance, and cost savings attributable to risk interventions, coordinating with finance for periodic validation.
• Proactive Risk Identification & Expansion — Proactively identify new risk patterns through systematic analysis of investigation outputs and region-specific vulnerability assessments. Drive cross-pollination of risk management learnings into adjacent operational functions and workstreams to expand the program’s impact beyond core scope.
• Business Reviews & Escalation Management — Own and drive operational review cadences including business review content preparation and escalation management. Perform deep-dive analysis and draft COE based on identified deviations and recommend appropriate solutions to ensure leadership visibility into program health and outcomes.
• Investigation Oversight & Triage — Oversee the investigation triage process — reviewing flagged cases from monitoring dashboards, determining root cause, validating operational justifications, identifying gaps in controls and processes, and managing escalations in consultation with legal where required.
• Technology Partnership & Monitoring Enhancement — Partner with automation and technology teams on dashboard enhancements, detection logic refinement, and false positive reduction to continuously improve monitoring accuracy, coverage, and program efficiencies.
• Project Delivery & Execution — Develop appropriate milestones and launch project schedules to ensure timely and successful delivery of projects and standard work (e.g., audits/reviews, licensing).
• Program Alignment & Business Understanding — Ensure program alignment with the risk strategy, regulations, policies, and team objectives. Understand the business needs and workflows owned by your team including financial risk, controls, escalation paths, data sources, metrics, testing mechanisms, key dependencies, automation/tools, and risk-assessment methodologies.
• Stakeholder Management & Risk Culture — Maintain structured stakeholder cadences with country-specific leadership, operations execution, procurement, and carrier management teams across all assigned RoW geographies. Support risk reporting and risk-aware culture initiatives across RoW countries.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

job_title: Senior Investigation Specialist, Last Mile - Flex VoD
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
The Rabbit App Bug Triage (RABT) team is part of the Voice of Driver (VoD) organization within Worldwide Flex Driver Partner Insights & Experience (WW DPIX). VoD is responsible for identifying, interpreting, and acting on signals that indicate friction in the Delivery Partner (DP) experience across the Amazon Flex journey.

RABT owns the operational mechanism for identifying, validating, and triaging potential defects in the Rabbit application. The team consolidates feedback from multiple sources, including Driver Support contacts, station escalations, country teams, social media, and app reviews, and converts those signals into structured, evidence-based technical investigations.

The team’s role is not limited to defect intake. RABT determines whether a reported issue is actionable, reconstructs the affected DP journey using available operational and technical signals, assesses recurrence and potential blast radius, removes duplicate noise, and provides engineering teams with sufficiently complete evidence to accelerate root-cause analysis and resolution. The team also identifies systemic gaps in product behavior, operational mechanisms, and diagnostic coverage, and works with partner teams to improve both defect detection and the quality of upstream signals.

RABT is looking for a Senior Investigation Specialist who can independently manage complex investigations, work through incomplete or ambiguous information, and translate large volumes of DP feedback and operational data into clear technical findings.

The ideal candidate will combine strong investigative judgment with analytical capability and operational rigor. The role requires regular use of SQL, dashboards, logs, case history, system signals, and internal diagnostic tools to validate hypotheses and quantify impact. The successful candidate will also work closely with Program Managers, Product Managers, Software Development Managers, Engineers, Operations teams, and other stakeholders across geographies.

In addition to managing individual investigations, the role will contribute to improving RABT’s broader operating mechanisms, including SOPs, quality controls, taxonomy, automation, AI-assisted triage, and defect-intake processes.

Key job responsibilities
1. Independently investigate and triage complex Rabbit app issues using DP feedback, operational data, logs, system signals, and internal diagnostic tools.
2. Determine issue actionability, identify failure patterns, distinguish product defects from operational or expected behavior, and assess potential blast radius.
3. Create clear, evidence-backed technical tickets that enable Product and Engineering teams to investigate and resolve issues efficiently.
4. Analyze trends and recurring defects using SQL, Excel, dashboards, and other analytical tools to identify emerging risks and systemic problems.
Partner with Program, Product, Engineering, Operations, and country teams to drive high-impact issues through investigation, escalation, and closure.

Support the launch of new programs, categories, and features to foster innovation and growth.

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
The Advertising Lever Specialist team is a multilingual team supporting Sellers enrolled in the Strategic Account Services (SAS) program. The SAS program partners with growing businesses on Amazon, providing strategic consultancy through a data-driven, collaborative, and customer-obsessed approach across different levers, including Advertising.

As team lead for the Advertising Lever Specialist team, you will lead a team of currently seven Lever Specialists. They support SAS-enrolled Sellers in their local language across five European markets, helping them manage a book of business of up to 50 Sellers through Advertising campaign creation and optimization.

Key job responsibilities
• Manage, coach, and mentor a team of Advertising specialists covering five European markets.
• Set team dynamics and SOPs, including definition of the scorecard, aligned with SAS and Advertising teams.
• Set clear performance objectives, track performance, and provide regular feedback to team members.
• Identify training and development needs and implement upskilling initiatives.
• Provide one-to-one support and ongoing development to the team.
• Monitor team productivity and quality of work, and implement process improvements.
• Collaborate with SAS and Advertising teams to identify issues and remove blockers.
• Analyze data to track team performance and inform decision-making.
• Identify opportunities to improve Advertising support for SAS-enrolled Sellers.
• Foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performing team culture.
• Prepare documentation on best practices, procedures, and frameworks for innovation.

A day in the life
Your days are varied and fast-paced. You might start the morning on a meeting with a team member, helping them align on weekly priorities with the Sellers they support. Later, you will join a call with the SAS Advertising module lead to review team and Seller performance, sharing wins and troubleshooting challenges together. In between, you will have focused time with a team member to build a tailored Advertising plan for a Seller in the book of business, using AI-powered tools to work efficiently and surface insights faster. You will also attend specialized Advertising training to sharpen your expertise, or join a development session to keep growing professionally.

About the team
The Advertising Lever Specialist team has ambitious plans to support SAS Sellers in Advertising. We are continuing to support more SAS-enrolled Sellers, driving their growth through Advertising and improving their overall Advertising experience on Amazon. The team operates with an entrepreneurial mindset, and you will have the opportunity to shape strategy at a European level, own high-impact projects, and develop recognized expertise alongside high-potential teammates. You will work alongside talented colleagues across Europe in a team that values ownership, innovation, and delivering exceptional results for our Sellers.

Basic qualifications
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent
• Experience within e-commerce, Retail, or Advertising fields
• Three or more years of professional non-internship marketing experience, preferably as a team lead in an Advertising organization
• Experience managing teams, helping them grow and deliver results
• Experience exceeding targets using a consultative, solutions-focused approach or equivalent
• Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
• Experience with communication, presentation, and negotiation
• Strong analytical skills including Microsoft Excel

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 3+ years of partnering with cross functional teams experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs

job_title: Analyst II, Network Strategy and Performance
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
As an Analyst within the Network Strategy Performance team, you will own analytics that directly shape where and how Amazon serves customers globally. You will model network scenarios spanning 100+ sites across 40+ countries, inform multi-year investment decisions, and deliver insights that influence headcount allocation, site strategy, and contact routing for one of the world's largest customer service networks.
This isn't a reporting role — you'll tackle ambiguous, high-stakes questions: Where should we expand next? How do we balance cost-to-serve against customer experience across geographies? What's the optimal site mix for the next three years? Your analysis will flow directly into monthly, OP and 3YP cycles that leadership uses to allocate resources.
You will partner closely with Operations, Products, FP&A, and Service Delivery teams — identifying gaps, measuring performance, and driving automation and process improvement initiatives. You will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs.

Key job responsibilities
- Own analytical inputs for network planning — model contact allocation scenarios, site investment options, and capacity strategies across geographies. Build and maintain the frameworks that determine how millions of weekly customer contacts are distributed across the global CS network, coordinating with Finance, and Service Delivery teams to ensure alignment with cost and CX targets.
- Translate complex or ambiguous network strategy questions into structured analysis — e.g., site expansion feasibility, cost-to-serve trade-offs, regional performance variance. Dive into the heart of ambiguous problems with non-defined inputs and outputs, identify root causes driving site or network-level performance gaps, and derive recommendations that influence headcount allocation, site investment, and network architecture decisions.
- Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of planning outputs. Develop side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.
- Design, implement, and support self-service analytics platforms that provide business teams with ad-hoc access to large datasets. Drive automation of data requirements by scaling data processes, creating dashboards, and building efficient queries across diverse data sources (contact volumes, productivity metrics, cost data, CX scores) to provide a holistic view of network performance.
- Communicate complex analytical insights and translate network performance data into clear narratives for Finance, Service delivery and senior leadership. Present analysis to leadership audiences with clarity and conviction. Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions (OP, 3YP, QXG), producing well-structured documents that tie conclusions to business outcomes.

About the team
The Network Strategy and Performance (NSP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.
We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, execution and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.
The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking an L5 Labor Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- 2+ years of supply chain experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience

Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations.

Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents.
Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.

Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.

The Cross-Border (XB) Science & Analytics team is at the heart of Amazon's international marketplace expansion, powering science-driven solutions that enable customers across 20+ countries to discover and purchase products seamlessly across borders. job_description:
DESCRIPTION
We are looking for a talented Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning and computer vision models that solve real-world problems at scale in the Amazon grocery domain. You will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to turn complex technical challenges into production-ready solutions, and own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment. You will bring scientific rigor to every stage — from data analysis and model design to evaluation and iteration. This is a high-impact role where your models will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.

Key job responsibilities
Design, train, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning models for complex grocery-domain problems including product identification, shelf perception, and in-store scene understanding — iterating rapidly from prototype to production-quality solutions

Conduct rigorous exploratory data analysis to characterize domain-specific challenges (image variability, catalog gaps, label noise) and translate findings into actionable modeling decisions

Own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment — collaborating with software and ML engineers to ensure models meet latency, throughput, and reliability requirements at production scale

Design and execute offline and online evaluation frameworks — defining metrics that capture both model performance and downstream business impact, and diagnosing failure modes to prioritize improvements

Build and improve data pipelines and annotation workflows that feed model training, including active learning strategies to maximize label efficiency

Communicate technical results, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders — connecting model behavior to customer experience outcomes

Stay current with state-of-the-art research in computer vision, multimodal learning, and representation learning — evaluating and adapting promising techniques to team-specific problems

Contribute to a culture of scientific rigor through reproducible experimentation, thorough documentation, peer code and design reviews, and raising the quality bar for the team

You'll present findings to product and business stakeholders, translating technical results into actionable recommendations. Throughout the day, you'll balance rigorous scientific thinking with practical engineering constraints, knowing your work directly improves the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.

DESCRIPTION
Payroll Tech's Sheriff team develops and maintains ML and Generative AI applications that support Payroll Operations and Amazon employees at scale. Our portfolio includes Pay-Input Anomaly Detection, which improves the pay experience by identifying pay input irregularities such as leaves and insurance discrepancies; Percept, which improves ticket resolution by providing intelligent ticket prioritization via sentiment scoring, ticket summarization, defect classification, and categorization; Penny, a Virtual Assistant that enables payroll operations teams to efficiently retrieve information from multiple sources including policies, Percept data, vendor data, and HR data via Xylem through a single browser interface; Pay Ticket Genie, in process of being integrated with Amazon AZA(A to Z Assistant); Niyam, our rule engine; and Policy as Code Extraction (PoCo), a critical component of SPACE (Single Payroll Autonomous and Computation Engine) Amazon's in-house payroll system built to eliminate third-party vendor dependency for payroll processing. PoCo ensures data accuracy by validating that pay instructions are correct and performing calculations when required. It consists of two components: policy-based rule creation, where business owners select a pay code and provide policy links to generate rules for specific business processes, and rule evaluation, where upstream services send real-time validation or calculation requests and receive results along with rationale for any failures. Sheriff team owns policy-based rule creation and powering the rule evaluation system with rules generated.

job_title: Applied Scientist, Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI)
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Alexa+ is Amazon’s next-generation, AI-powered virtual assistant. Building on the original Alexa, it uses generative AI to deliver a more conversational, personalised, and effective experience. Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI) team is developing responsible AI (RAI) solutions for Alexa+, empowering it to provide useful information responsibly.

The Mission
Build AI safety systems that protect millions of Alexa customers every day. As conversational AI evolves, you'll solve challenging problems in Responsible AI by ensuring LLMs provide safe, trustworthy responses, building AI systems that understand nuanced human values across cultures, and maintaining customer trust at scale.

What You'll Build
You'll pioneer breakthrough solutions in Responsible AI at Amazon's scale. Imagine training models that set new safety standards, designing automated testing systems that hunt for vulnerabilities before they surface, and certifying the systems that power millions of daily conversations. You'll create intelligent evaluation systems that judge responses with human-level insight, build models that truly understand what makes interactions safe and delightful, and craft feedback mechanisms that help Alexa+ grasp the nuances of complex customer conversations. Here's where it gets even more exciting: you'll build AI agents that act as your team's safety net—automatically detecting and fixing production issues in real-time, often before anyone notices there was a problem. Your innovations won't just improve Alexa+; they'll fundamentally shape how it learns, evolves, and earns customer trust. As Alexa+ continues to delight customers, your work ensures it becomes more trustworthy, safer, and deeply aligned with customer needs and expectations.

Your work directly protects customer trust at Amazon's scale. Every innovation you create—from novel safety mechanisms to sophisticated evaluation techniques—shapes how millions of people interact with AI confidently. You're not just building products; you're defining industry standards for responsible AI.

This is frontier research with immediate real-world impact. You'll tackle problems that require innovative solutions: training models that remain truthful and grounded across diverse contexts, building reward models that capture the nuanced spectrum of human values across cultures and languages, and creating automated systems that continuously discover and address potential issues before customers encounter them. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform state-of-the-art ideas into production systems serving millions.

What We're Looking For

* Deep expertise in state-of-the-art NLP, Large Language Models
* Track record of building scalable ML systems
* Passion for impactful research—where frontier science meets real-world responsibility at scale
* Excitement about solving problems that will shape the future of AI

Ready to work on AI safety challenges that define the industry? Join us.

Key job responsibilities
The Responsible AI (RAI) team is at the forefront of building AI systems that are safe, ethical, and trustworthy. As an Applied Scientist-II, you'll be a key contributor to end-to-end Responsible AI solutions—developing and refining algorithms that detect and eliminate false information, building models that identify vulnerabilities exploited by bad actors, and training systems that understand human values across diverse cultures. Working alongside world-class engineers and scientists, you'll apply state-of-the-art NLP and computer vision techniques to content classification and safety challenges—turning cutting-edge research into production systems that protect millions of customers daily.

But here's what makes this role exciting: you'll grow into a future leader. You'll contribute to identifying, defining, and mitigating AI safety risks early—helping protect customers before they're impacted—while building deep expertise in responsible AI. You'll work within multi-agent architectures, implementing components where distributed AI systems maintain human oversight and control. Every model you build and every experiment you run—from consensus-driven reasoning modules to orchestration components—will directly strengthen trustworthy AI at the world's largest scale.
But here's what makes this role truly special: you'll shape the future. You'll lead efforts to identify, define, and mitigate risks early—protecting customers before they're impacted—and mentor the next generation of AI safety experts. You'll design multi-agent architectures where distributed AI systems exhibit emergent collective intelligence while maintaining human oversight and control. Every innovation you drive—from consensus-driven reasoning frameworks to sophisticated orchestration patterns—will set new standards for trustworthy AI at the world's largest scale.

A day in the life
As a Responsible AI Scientist, you're at the frontier of AI safety—experimenting with breakthrough techniques that push the boundaries of what's possible. You partner with engineering to transform research into production-ready solutions, tackling complex optimization challenges. You brainstorm with Product teams, translating ambitious visions into concrete objectives that drive real impact. Your expertise shapes critical deployment decisions as you review impactful work and guide go/no-go calls. You mentor the next generation of AI safety leaders, watching ideas spark and capabilities grow. This is where science meets impact—building AI that's not just intelligent, but trustworthy and aligned with human values.

About the team
Our team pioneers Responsible AI for conversational assistants. We ensure Alexa delivers safe, trustworthy experiences across all devices, modalities, and languages worldwide. We work on frontier AI safety challenges—and we're looking for scientists who want to help shape the future of trustworthy AI.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, C++

job_title: Applied Scientist, Amazon Music - Catalog Quality
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music.

The Music Catalog Quality team at Amazon Music serves a key role in developing solutions to ensure and improve the quality of catalog metadata and content across the music streaming experience. We create solutions that detect, measure, and remediate quality issues in music metadata - including artist information, track attributes, versions, content tags, and provide actionable insights that enable continuous improvement of the catalog. We leverage a host of scientific and engineering technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and automated data validation pipelines.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist, you will own the design and development of end-to-end systems. You’ll have the opportunity to create technical roadmaps, and drive production level projects that will support Amazon Science. You will work closely with Amazon scientists, and other science interns to develop solutions and deploy them into production. The ideal scientist must have the ability to work with diverse groups of people and cross-functional teams to solve complex business problems. Other responsibilities include:

- Collaborate with scientists, engineers, and product managers to define and frame business problems as ML or optimization tasks.
- Use machine learning, deep learning, LLMs and Agentic AI techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems
- Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of Amazon's data to help automate and optimize key processes
- Design, development and evaluation of AI models for predictive learning
- Research and implement novel machine learning and statistical approaches
- Implement scalable data pipelines and model-serving systems.
- Analyze experimental results, draw insights, and refine models to improve accuracy and robustness.
- Communicate findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience using Unix/Linux
- PhD in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields

Amazon Robotics develops state-of-the art robotics for Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers. Come build the future of human-technology interaction with us. job_title: Associate, ML Data Operations, GO-AI Operations
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
This team enables automation at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers. This team serves Amazon Internal Fulfillment Technologies & Robotics teams by enabling automation, which includes real-time & offline (image/video) data auditing services. One of the key contributions of this team is supporting the fulfillment centers in maintaining inventory accuracy.

An Associate in this role is required to watch the video of the stowing action at a fulfillment center, understand it thoroughly and make best use of human judgement in combination with the tools and resources to indicate the activity captured in the video. They are expected to verify or mark the location of product through a tool while maintaining highest level of accuracy. This process helps in maintaining the fulfillment center's stow quality. This is an operational role. Under general supervision, the Associate performs precise and thorough video/image audits with high degree of accuracy and speed, thus aiding defect reduction.

Key job responsibilities
The Associate has to watch several hundred videos in a shift and provide responses by following goals on accuracy (quality), speed (productivity) and right / acceptable practices. Associates are required to take breaks at the pre-defined slots and ensure 6.8 to 7 hours’ time per day is spent to answer the videos. Associates who are hired to work from home should maintain (1) dedicated workspace i.e., table, chair & sufficient lighting (2) workspace / work related data shouldn’t be accessed by anyone other than employee

The candidate is expected to demonstrate:
• Willingness to work in Non-tech role for contract duration of 6 months
• Ability to audit image/video/text based Jobs
• Ability to identify details from blurry, less sharp videos and provide correct response. Requires high level of attention & focus on screen
• Willingness to work on incremental targets/goals on quality & productivity
• Fast Pace of implementation & consistent performance
• Ability to work in rotational shifts (including night shifts), remote teams and exceptionally good team player
• Readiness to come to office for few days (when required, applicable for associates working from home)
• Willing to switch ON laptop camera while on virtual meetings.

A day in the life
Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.

Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.

About the team
Data Auditing Operations team provides human support to Amazon Fulfillment facilities with goal of enabling hands-free active stowing through visual audits on videos/images. Videos with brief duration (typically between 15 and 20seconds) are sent to Operations Team for humans to audit them with information on products being stored at fulfilment centers. For business use, these videos must be thoroughly reviewed and audited using best human judgement. The effectiveness of automated process will be increased by using videos that Associates have audited. This process helps maintaining stow quality at fulfillment center and Associate will be further evaluated for performance improvements/coaching.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
The Audits and Insights team (AIT) – SPT Audit program measures accuracy of account enforcements, listing enforcements, all appeals and reinstatement decisions through audits on a statistically significant sample across Perfect Order Experience, Selling Partner Risk & Abuse, Financial Disincentives, Automated Brand Protection, Andon, Product Review Abuse, Restricted Products, Safety, Know Your Customer & Product Safety & Compliance (PSC) to name a few. We perform audits and measure the coverage and accuracy via director level goals and generate actionable insights from our audits to improve enforcement accuracy, appeal handling accuracy, First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate and eliminate unnecessary Seller friction by identifying ways to reduce Seller enforcements and appeals. We are committed to maintaining and advancing the trust of our Sellers by raising the bar through our Audits.

Key job responsibilities
1. Manage day-to-day operations of a team of senior auditors including planning of program audits, quality control, audit task allocation and reporting
2. Oversee the hiring & training of new team members and support their development
3. Ensure productivity is maximized through supervision, training, analysis, and feedback of performance data on a periodic basis
4. Work closely with Process Improvement PM on weekly flash to identify any key learnings /findings and metrics with regards to Ops Process Adherence, Program Improvement Opportunity, Escalation Management opportunity.
5. Collect, track, & present metrics related to processes, team accuracy and efficiency, and drive improvements in efficiency.
6. Communicate effectively with other operations and/or program managers regarding risks, mitigation strategies, and success of QA Program
7. Continuously evaluate tools and processes and offer solutions to ensure they are efficient, high quality, and scalable
8. Utilize strategic thinking to plan/develop team and site growth to support program delivery
9. Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues
10. Lead diverse talent within the team, work cross-functionally, and build consensus on difficult issues
11. Highlight weekly best performers by partnering with employee experience manager and bring out the best in the team.

A day in the life
The AIT Audit Manager II will work with their team to ensure audit delivery and generate key insights. They will coordinate with internal AIT stakeholder and external stakeholders to provide outputs of the audits, establish feedback mechanisms for operations, and communicate with leadership the efficacy of audits being executed.

About the team
The Audits & Insights Team (AIT) strives to ensure that Amazon's Seller and Buyer policies are effectively implemented by the investigation and automation mechanisms within the Selling Partner Services (SPS). We achieve this by - (1) Defect Identification and Remediation: keep Amazon stores safe and trustworthy for customers (Buyers & Sellers), by ensuring that they fully conform to our established policies and by identifying and ensuring the reversal of any incorrect actions (2) Metrics reporting: measure investigation, policy and process performance, and share the defects via periodic reports with the relevant stakeholders and (3) Insight generation and Recommendation: identify the gap and propose solutions to bridge gaps in policies, automation or tools and work with the business, policy, tech, operations etc. teams and taking those solutions to the implementation phase.

- 3+ years of auditing business processes, risk mitigation, program compliance or internal audits experience
- 5+ years of work in relevant industries such as law, customer service, investigations, risk, compliance or project management experience
- Experience in audits related to business processes, risk mitigation, program compliance, or internal audits
- Experience with all Microsoft Office applications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
- Experience working in risk, fraud or compliance organizations
- Master's degree or equivalent

- Opportunity to collaborate with product/program/operations teams to identify customer pain points and build innovative solutions
- Shape the future of identity verification by developing processes, tools, and leadership talent that reduce waste & abuse while ensuring compliance
- Drive automation and AI initiatives to scale verification capabilities, adapting to emerging business needs and launching automation solutions with measurable impact

-Apply data transformations and basic statistical techniques to support diagnostic analysis
-Support the design and maintenance of automated reporting systems, dashboards, and KPI visuals to track metrics

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
As part of Amazon India supply chain analytics team we are seeking for Business Intelligence Engineer who will have opportunities to work as a thought leader and solve complex business problems along with some of best business leaders. This is role is pivotal in bringing some of the industry’s best practices around BI architecture design and drive a roadmap which has large impact on business metrics. We are young team of engineer and analysts, building world class solutions, harness new ideas, look for new technologies and encourage thought process to solve business problems.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers. Amazon has great opportunities to pursue a career as a leader in supply chain analytics. We know that learning through experience is what transforms talented people into great leaders. Our roles are designed to accelerate the growth of leaders through challenging field experiences that stretch individual capability. Our Operations environment presents the candidates with great challenges in dealing with front line management, and driving scalable and continuous improvements across our Fulfillment Centers, Supply Chain & Transportation execution teams.

Key job responsibilities
Primary Responsibilities:

> As a BA you will use large complex data sets to perform analytics, discuss with business stakeholders to understand the problem, correlate business problems with deep data analysis, develop solution, run statistical tests on hypothesis, optimize the queries for optimal performance and build tools to automate the process and eliminate manual interventions. Your primary role will be to identify opportunities to improve operation performance, influence faster business decisions and reduce cost.
> You will also work as a program manager for your stakeholders, owning end-end deliveries of large analytics initiatives. You will develop roadmaps, align on project priorities and drive them to completion, while working with key stakeholder and mentoring business analysts in your team.
> This role requires one to be comfortable working from general guidelines, using best judgment to make sound business decision, have a history of teamwork and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done.
> This role requires strong analytical, problem solving and quantitative skills (advance experience in tools like Tableau or similar BI tools, SQL, Python/R etc.), build ETL data pipelines and an ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and justify business decisions.
> You will be a subject matter expert of best in class technologies within Amazon, you have the ability to map the infrastructure gap between other analytics team and build a roadmap to bridge those gaps. You will understand the intricate details of the supply chain operation process and understand impact at ground level.

Secondary Responsibilities:

We are looking for a Business Development Manager to own end-to-end strategy and execution for three new verticals under the Associates program: AI Content, Shoppable Media and Monetization. This is a charter-building role. You will take these verticals from 1 to 10, partnering with cross-functional teams inside Amazon and influencing CXO-level stakeholders at India's top publishers to build Amazon's distributed commerce engine.

This role is part of the Amazon India Performance Marketing team.

What Makes This Role Exciting

You will build, not just manage. Shoppable Media, AI Content, and Monetization are new verticals with significant potential. You will define the strategy, build the partnerships, and shape how Amazon India approaches distributed commerce.

You will operate at the intersection of media, commerce, and AI. This is one of the few roles where you get to work across publisher CXOs, Amazon Ads leadership, WW product teams, and Retail category heads, all in service of building something new.

The charter is real and the ambition is high. You are joining a team that is taking new verticals from 1 to 10 through strategy, meticulous execution, and fast experimentation. The opportunity to shape what comes next is wide open.

Develop and present spend insights, automation proposals, and process improvement recommendations to leadership — using data visualization and analytical platforms to communicate impact and prioritize initiatives.

job_title: Capacity Intelligence Analyst, Network Strategy & Performance
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
As a Capacity Intelligence Analyst within the Network Strategy & Performance team, you will support and execute labor planning for Amazon's Customer Service network, including outsourced (Global Outsourcing) sites. You will work at the intersection of data and operations — translating demand signals into accurate staffing plans that protect customer experience while contributing to cost efficiency.

You will operate independently within your workstream, navigating ambiguity with analytical rigor and sound judgment. You will build effective working relationships with CS Operations, Global Outsourcing (GO) Vendor Management, CS Finance, Service Delivery, and Planning Intelligence teams. You will present your analysis and recommendations independently to senior stakeholders, contribute to planning decisions through well-reasoned, data-backed arguments, and actively participate in the team's AI-driven transformation agenda.

This role participates in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews and contributes directly to outsourcing and staffing decisions across the CS network.

Key job responsibilities
- Support the development, maintenance, and execution of labor capacity plans for internal and outsourced sites, covering short-term (4-week), operational (monthly/quarterly), and long-term (3-year) planning horizons. Build toward full ownership of assigned planning workstreams.
- Proactively identify and flag capacity risks by mapping dependencies across internal sites and Global Outsourcing vendor partners. Communicate risks and proposed mitigation plans to stakeholders with clarity and specificity. Coordinate with CS Operations and GO Vendor Management teams to ensure staffing plans are aligned with service level targets and outsourcing strategy.
- Support quarterly submissions to CS Finance, contributing to accurate Year-to-Go (YTG) labor cost projections and revisions versus OP targets.
- Independently apply AI tools (e.g., AgentZ, Kiro) to improve planning workflows without prompting, identifying opportunities to increase the speed, quality, and scale of your planning outputs. Develop side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your planning workstream, and contribute concrete use cases to the team's AI adoption agenda.
- Develop structured frameworks to address recurring planning problems within your scope, reducing rework and improving the consistency of planning outputs over time.
- Present analysis and planning recommendations to senior stakeholder audiences independently, adapting your communication style for technical and non-technical, operational and strategic stakeholders. Write clear, concise, and compelling narratives for QBRs, MBRs, and planning reviews. Documents must meet Amazon's standard formatting guidelines, with conclusions that tie to the organization's working-backwards framework.
- Communicate planning analysis in a way that is accessible to senior, non-expert audiences, anticipating likely objections to your recommendations and addressing them proactively.

Core Competencies
- AI Fluency: Independently applies AI tools to improve planning workflows without prompting. Develops side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your own workstream. Coaches at least one peer on AI tool usage. Contributes to the team's AI adoption agenda with concrete use cases demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.
- Critical Thinking: Independently diagnoses complex planning problems. Challenges assumptions — including your own — with data. Develops structured frameworks to address recurring problems within your scope. Anticipates the most likely objections to a recommendation and addresses them proactively.
- Executive Presence: Presents analysis and recommendations to senior audiences independently. Adapts communication style for different stakeholders — technical and non-technical, operational and strategic. Handles pushback constructively without becoming defensive or capitulating without reason.
- Problem Solving: Navigates ambiguous problems with limited guidance. Develops multiple solution options with explicit trade-off analysis. Drives problems to resolution end-to-end — does not hand off and forget. Learns from misses and applies those learnings to the next problem.
- Boundaryless: Builds effective working relationships with key partner teams — Service Delivery, CS Finance, and GO Vendor Management. Proactively identifies and resolves cross-team dependencies before they become blockers. Represents Network Strategy & Performance in partner forums with credibility.

About the team
The Network Strategy & Performance (NSP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.

We analyze historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.

The Network Strategy & Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking an experienced Capacity Intelligence Analyst to join this team and contribute to how Amazon plans, staffs, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
- 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
- Experience with Excel
- Experience with SQL
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Master's degree in a quantitative field or Business Administration.
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification.

- Experience presenting analytical recommendations to manager or director-level audiences.

Key job responsibilities
The responsibilities of the DCCD Cx Commissioning Engineer (CxE) include, but are not limited to, oversight and coordination of multi-discipline division of work related to pre-commissioning and commissioning of Amazon critical infrastructure construction and special projects.

The CxE is responsible for supporting and supervising vendors, contractors and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems including medium and low voltage power systems, Generators, UPS, HVAC, Chilled Water, BMS and EPMS systems. They provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, designing and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review all multi-discipline integrated systems testing and commissioning documents to ensure they are compliant with the basis of design, specifications and standards of the project.

The CxE is responsibile to ensure that all commissioning procedures follow the appropriate safety practices, policies and procedures. They enthusiastically participates in all project and company safety programs. CxE must also audit commissioning activities continuously to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. The CxE proactively communicates with the DCCD Cx Regional Manager and the DCCD Cx team to ensure that the applicable test documents are created in accordance with all commissioning requirements. Following the AWS project reporting format, the CxE is responsible for weekly reporting of commissioning progress and metrics for assigned project. The CxE will work on multiple initiatives and projects simultaneously, under tight deadlines according to prescribed metrics.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems that ensure the health of AWS data centers. Operating across Australia & New Zealand, India, North Asia, and Southeast Asia, APAC CDS manages 41 leased/owned sites and supports global follow-the-sun operations. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines: deployments (control systems in new data centers), projects (capital improvement works at live sites), and service (control systems at live sites), with additional specializations in colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, program management, and coordination.

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.

To be successful in this team, you will also have:
- Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
- Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
- Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.

Key job responsibilities
• Assist in the review and processing of control system change orders, scope of work (SOW) adjustments, and vendor deliverables
• Provide administrative and technical support for BMS and EPMS commissioning activities, including functional testing documentation and system acceptance
• Manage control system project documentation including Controls Points Lists, sequence of operations, network architecture diagrams, and as-built drawings in WorkDocs, SharePoint folders, and Wiki Pages
• Coordinate with Technical Program Managers (TPM), Construction Managers (CM), and Amazon Commissioning (ACx) teams on control system deployment schedules and milestones
• Support the maintenance and organization of control system standards, specifications, and BOD documentation
• Assist in tracking control system installation progress, testing completion, and production readiness milestones
• Gather feedback from control engineers, field teams, and stakeholders to improve control deployment workflows and processes
• Support the development and maintenance of control system training materials and technical documentation

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, gets energy from connecting people and ideas, and measures their success by the outcomes they enable rather than the authority they hold. DESCRIPTION
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Primary responsibilities and SME fields include, but are not limited to:

Operations and Maintenance:

· Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
· Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
· Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
· Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
· Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
· Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.
· Manage the engineering aspects of the Data Centers related to financial and cost control, code and regulatory compliance, personnel management, staff training and development
· Health & Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
· Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
· Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
· Providing hands on facility support where required (e.g. installation of new equipment, decommissioning of equipment, replacement of faulty equipment, internal audits…etc.)
· Oversee technical compliance auditing and the effective and timely close out of corrective action plans. Perform annual operational reviews with a focus on compliance with the Amazon standards and all applicable regulatory requirements. (Audits).
· Manage the development and delivery of the portfolio of Energy/Environmental Management Programs. Keep abreast of Data Center industry innovation.

Incident and Emergency Response:
o Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
o Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.
o Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.

Key job responsibilities
The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

•Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
•Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
•Work with DCO managers (IT) and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
•Responsible for supporting the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling.

A day in the life
•Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
•Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
•Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
•Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
•Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
•Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Amazon's IT Services (ITS) team is seeking a detail-oriented Data Center Material Associate, Warehouse (Reverse Logistics) to support the recovery, tracking, and lifecycle management of IT assets within our India operations. You will act as the central coordination point between internal stakeholders, logistics partners, and asset-management systems to drive timely asset returns and maintain a high IT-clearance completion rate. The position combines operational execution, data accuracy, and strong communication, working within established policies and standard operating procedures.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys structured, process-driven work with measurable outcomes. You will contribute directly to inventory accuracy, cost avoidance, and compliance goals while gaining exposure to large-scale operations, logistics coordination, and IT asset-management tooling. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and take pride in operational excellence, we encourage you to apply.

Key job responsibilities
- Asset recovery coordination: Manage the day-to-day queue of reverse-logistics cases, ensuring IT assets are recovered promptly and tracked through each stage of the return process.

- Stakeholder communication: Send structured notifications and reminders to relevant stakeholders, follow up on pending returns, and respond to queries in a professional, timely manner.

- Logistics partner coordination: Work with third-party logistics providers to schedule pickups, confirm shipments, and validate receipt of assets at designated locations.

- Data accuracy & tracking: Maintain accurate records of asset status, movements, and discrepancies using asset-management and tracking tools; reconcile data to ensure inventory integrity.

- Discrepancy resolution: Identify and resolve mismatches, missing items, or tagging errors by collaborating with internal teams and following defined escalation paths.

- Clearance & compliance: Support IT-clearance workflows and ensure processes adhere to organizational policies and audit requirements.

- Reporting: Prepare and share regular status updates and queue reports to provide visibility into operational performance and open items.

- Process improvement: Identify recurring issues and suggest improvements to increase efficiency, reduce turnaround time, and improve the overall return experience.

- Documentation: Maintain clear, organized records to support traceability and knowledge continuity across the team.
