On a typical day, you will review and prioritize the reverse-logistics case queue, send notifications and follow-up reminders for pending asset returns, and coordinate pickups and shipments with logistics partners. You will update asset-tracking systems with current statuses, confirm receipts, and reconcile any data discrepancies. Part of your day involves responding to stakeholder queries, escalating blocked cases through defined channels, and verifying that recovered assets are correctly logged and processed. Prepare short status updates summarizing queue health and open items. Throughout, you will apply standard operating procedures to keep cases moving and ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.

About the team
You will join the **ITS Reverse Logistics team**, a group dedicated to managing the recovery and lifecycle of IT assets across Amazon's India operations. The team ensures that equipment is efficiently returned, verified, and processed as employees transition, directly supporting inventory accuracy, cost efficiency, and compliance goals. We work closely with internal IT, logistics partner and logistics partners, using modern asset-management and tracking tools to coordinate a high volume of cases at scale. The team values accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement, and offers a collaborative, process-driven environment where your contributions have a clear, measurable impact on operational performance.

Key job responsibilities
Primary responsibilities and SME fields include, but are not limited to:

Operations and Maintenance:

· Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of investigation, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
· Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of a Data Center (Electrical/Mechanical/Fire Suppression Systems) are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
· Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
· Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
· Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
· Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.

o Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.

The EU Marketing & Prime organization is looking for a Data Scientist to join the PRIMAS team. This role sits at the intersection of applied statistics and large-scale analytics — you'll design experiments and causal models, and also own the data pipelines, metrics, and reporting infrastructure that make those results usable across the business.

You will work at the forefront of consumer analytics, tackling some of the hardest measurement problems in the industry alongside strong scientists, statisticians, and software engineers.

1. Design and implement scalable, statistically rigorous experiments (A/B, geo, holdout, quasi-experiments) to measure marketing incrementality across channels.

This role sits at the intersection of applied statistics and large-scale analytics — you'll design experiments and causal models, and also own the data pipelines, metrics, and reporting infrastructure that make those results usable across the business.

The PRIMAS team provides a comprehensive understanding of customer segments, affinities, and lifetime value. We use data science tools and advanced statistical techniques to study customer purchase and engagement behaviors, and generate actionable insights on where, when, and how we deliver products and programs to customers. You will design, launch, and measure experiments across marketing channels (SEM/SEO, Affiliates, Display, Social, Mobile, Email, Onsite, etc.), engagement products, and customer segments. You will improve our understanding of customer behavior, run rigorous power and minimum detectable effect (MDE) analyses to size experiments correctly, and build the causal and conversion models that value and target our marketing — then build the pipelines and dashboards that keep those signals flowing reliably to stakeholders and downstream systems. You will work at the forefront of consumer analytics, tackling some of the hardest measurement problems in the industry alongside strong scientists, statisticians, and software engineers.

1. Design and implement scalable, statistically rigorous experiments (A/B, geo, holdout, quasi-experiments) to measure marketing incrementality across channels.

Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.

To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build & manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cuttingedge data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.

Key job responsibilities
A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

• You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
• Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
• You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
• You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
• You perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
• You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
• You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
• You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
• More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
• This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift & rack equipment up to 18kg; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines.
• This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

DESCRIPTION
As a Design Verification (DV) Engineer, you will be part of an advanced architecture team that is exploring new hardware designs to improve our devices. In this role, you will be responsible for defining the verification methodology and implementing the corresponding test plan for advanced functional blocks. You will participate in the design verification and bring-up of such blocks by writing relevant assertions, debugging code, test benches, test harnesses, and otherwise interacting with the extended team.

You will work closely with multi-disciplinary groups including Product Design, Audio Technology, Computer Vision, Hardware Engineering, and Software Engineering, to architect and implement complex functional block that enable development of world-class hardware devices. In this role, you will:

· Design world class hardware and software
· Communicate and work with team members across multiple disciplines
· Deliver detailed test plans for verification of complex digital design blocks by working with design engineers and architects
· Create and enhance constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM
· Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
· Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
· Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.
· Participate in test plan and coverage reviews
· Integrated 3rd party IPs/VIPs and transactors
· Perform IP/SOC bringup in simulation, emulation and prototyping environments

The ideal candidate should have experience with RTL development environments, fluency in modern hardware description languages and verification methodologies. - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Experience identifying bugs in architecture, algorithms, functionality, and performance with strong overall debugging skills
- Experience verifying at multiple levels of logic from IP blocks to SoCs to full system testing
- Experience using multiple verification platforms: UVM test bench, FPGA, emulator, software environments, and system testing
- Experience with test plan development, building the necessary test bench infrastructure, developing tests and verifying the design
- Experience with industry standard tools and scripting languages (Python or Perl) for automation
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- 7+ years or more of practical semiconductor design verification including System Verilog, UVM, assertions and coverage driven verification.
- Experience defining verification methodologies
- Experience with writing directed/constrained-random tests

- Master's degree in Electrical or Communications Engineering or a related field
- Experience in system-level debugging

- Escalate cases that cannot be resolved through standard editing procedures or require further investigation, clarification, or redelivery from content partners.

- Good communication skills and ability to document findings clearly and accurately.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage workload effectively.

- Exposure to digital media delivery workflows, content validation pipelines, and asset management systems.
- Familiarity with multilingual audio tracks and descriptive audio (AD) tracks.
- Experience working with audio and video reference assets for quality comparison and validation.
- Knowledge of video codecs, container formats (MP4, MKV, MOV), and transcoding concepts.
- Experience with subtitle quality control, including timing validation and linguistic review coordination.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver consistently under tight timelines in a production environment.

Amazon Web Services is seeking a Electrical Engineer to become part of a world class engineering team to lead the Electrical design of our Data Center Substations across our rapidly expanding Asia Pacific (APAC) portfolio.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We're looking for candidates that share our customer obsession by providing innovative solutions to enhance our market leading reliability. Technical leaders that can explain complex systems in clear and concise language. We contribute to our global body of knowledge and drive a cycle of continuous improvement at a global scale.

We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience across the project lifecycle from concept design through construction, to commissioning and handover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the electrical engineering field. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As an electrical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, consultants and contractors.

Key job responsibilities
The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for the following:
- Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
- Work with internal teams to understand user requirements.
- Design and manage high and medium voltage substation systems on concurrent projects across multiple geographical regions
- Develop comprehensive electrical infrastructure designs using advanced engineering software
- Collaborate with regional vendors, manufacturers, and utility providers to specify optimal electrical equipment
- Creation of designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.
- Work with local utilities to understand and define site utility requirements.
- Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes.
- Review and approval of equipment submittals.
- Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases.
- Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems.
- Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and startup as needed.
- Having fun and offering creative, out of the box solutions.

About the team
We are a global engineering team dedicated to continuous improvement and technological excellence. The APAC HV Design team thrives on challenging conventional approaches and creating scalable, efficient power infrastructure such as High Voltage Substations and Grid Connections. We value creativity, technical expertise, and a collaborative spirit that drives Amazon's mission forward.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- 4+ years of commissioning experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Experience in commissioning
- Bachelor’s degree in an electrical engineering or equivalent, including a minimum of 5 years of substation design experience.
- 4+ years of Experience developing design documentation (plans, specifications, etc) for construction and/or permitting.
- Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- Experience with design or construction administration of a variety of electrical distribution systems ranging from low voltage to high voltage

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Professional Engineer License
- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- 3+ years of experience directly related to substation design supporting data center or mission critical facilities.
- Solid understanding of critical data center electrical equipment.
- Possess leadership and problem solving skills.

job_title: Executive Search Researcher, Principal Engineer Recruiting
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Join Amazon's Executive Recruiting team and help us identify and hire the world's most exceptional Principal Engineers. Members of Amazon's Principal Engineering Community are exemplary practitioners and pragmatic visionaries who set the standard for engineering excellence across Amazon. This role offers unparalleled visibility - you'll work across all Amazon businesses, advising senior executives on hiring strategy while building relationships with world-renowned technical leaders.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Search Design: Develop robust, multi-channel strategies attracting world-class engineers. Map target companies, engage at conferences, generate referral leads. Build talent networks and tap industry sources for ongoing candidate pools.

Executive Advisory: Serve as talent adviser to leaders across Amazon - educating hiring managers about the external Principal Engineer demographic. Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on top technical talent. Conduct continuous company and talent mapping.

Candidate Development: Develop prospects into candidates through sophisticated engagement. Perform assessment and screening, present to executive leadership. Conduct phone interviews, prepare candidates for technical interviews, coach leaders on talent acquisition at senior levels.

Market Expertise: Serve as expert for engineering recruiting. Contribute to knowledge base with education on industries and talent pools. Learn new domains quickly and craft effective search strategies.

A day in the life
You'll map technical leadership at target companies, identifying Principal Engineers working on problems similar to Amazon's strategic initiatives. You'll craft multi-channel engagement strategies - attending technical conferences, leveraging networks for warm introductions to passive candidates who would be transformational hires.
You'll advise VPs on search parameters based on market realities, conduct phone screens with renowned engineers assessing technical depth and influence capability, and coach hiring managers on candidate engagement. You'll contribute to the team's knowledge base by documenting insights about emerging talent pools that inform future searches.

About the team
The Principal Engineering Recruiting team is the talent acquisition engine for Amazon's PE Community. We take a multi-channel approach (target company mapping, conference and event engagement, referral and network lead generation) to talent identification, engagement, assessment, and match-making. job_description:
DESCRIPTION
The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) team sits at the core of Amazon's global supply chain — determining what inventory to buy, when to buy it, how much to order, where to position it, and how to recover value from unproductive inventory — all to delight customers while meeting Amazon's business objectives. Operating at massive scale across hundreds of product lines and billions of dollars of worldwide inventory, SCOT's fully in-house, automated planning and optimization systems are among the most sophisticated in the world. Finance within SCOT is a high-impact function, partnering directly with AI and machine learning engineers, scientists, product managers, and operations leaders to shape strategy, drive investment decisions, and deliver measurable improvements to Amazon's supply chain economics.

--The Role--

We're looking for a Finance Manager who thrives in deep business partnership with senior executives, including Directors and VPs — serving as the financial owner for our Rest of World Automated Inventory Management portfolio, covering India, Japan, AMET (Africa, Middle East, and Turkey), and emerging markets across Latin America and Asia Pacific.

This role sits at the intersection of finance and AI in supply chain — with high agency, a direct line to the regional leaders defining Amazon's inventory strategy across some of its fastest-growing markets, and the autonomy to drive investment decisions as the financial voice shaping how these systems are built, extended, and scaled into new geographies.

We seek a candidate who is curious about how AI-driven autonomous systems shape business outcomes — comfortable interrogating model inputs, challenging assumptions, and asking "is this optimizing for the right thing?" You build trust quickly, partner closely with technical and business leaders, and know how to show up as a strategic equal at the table. You're comfortable operating at multiple altitudes — equally at ease with a data model as you are presenting to a VP.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with Science and Product teams to develop financial strategies and drive controllership across RoW Automated Inventory Management systems, ensuring technology investments deliver maximum long-term free cash flow and measurable improvements to supply chain efficiency across markets ranging from early-stage builds in AMET to accelerating system maturity in Japan and India
- Navigate high degrees of ambiguity to build financial models that evaluate technology investments in markets at varying stages of maturity — from India, which is undergoing significant network transformation, to Japan, which is scaling rapidly, to AMET, a regional team in its second year of operation with significant growth ahead
- Conduct rigorous financial assessments of identified inventory defects — including entitlement analysis, estimation accuracy, and opportunity costs — translating findings into measurable P&L impact across the network
- Build and maintain metrics and audit mechanisms to evaluate algorithmic decision outcomes in RoW markets, flagging when models underperform and surfacing data-driven recommendations to course-correct
- Develop compelling narratives and financial analyses for regional and global executive reviews
- Leverage AI agents, GenAI assistants, and AI-powered data platforms to accelerate analysis, improve productivity, and continuously explore new ways to deliver higher-quality insights faster

A day in the life
This role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and supply chain strategy. You'll spend your time working shoulder-to-shoulder with operations research scientists, product managers, and engineers — engaging in model design discussions, stress-testing algorithmic assumptions, and translating system behavior into financial narratives that drive strategic decisions. No two days look the same: one day you're building a financial framework to evaluate a new algorithm with an engineer; the next you're presenting findings in a VP-level review where the outcome shapes how Amazon invests in its inventory infrastructure.

About the team
This role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and supply chain strategy across some of Amazon's most dynamic and fast-growing markets. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with regional operations research scientists, product managers, and engineers — engaging in model design discussions, stress-testing algorithmic assumptions, and translating system behavior into financial narratives that drive strategic decisions. The problems here are less defined than in mature markets — systems are being extended, launched, and adapted for the first time — which means you'll have real influence over how Amazon builds its inventory infrastructure in these regions. One day you're evaluating the financial case for a new system launch in India; the next you're shaping the financial framework for how Amazon expands its supply chain operations in AMET, or stress-testing assumptions behind Japan's next wave of automation. No two days look the same.
The culture is direct, curious, and intellectually honest. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with scientists, engineers, and product managers, ask hard questions, and show up as strategic equals.

Global Payroll Payment Operations

Establish mechanisms to monitor payment health, service levels, control performance, operational risks, and critical dependencies.

Manage relationships with payment service providers, fintechs, financial institutions, and third-party vendors.
Partner with banks on service levels, payment requirements, file specifications, connectivity, format changes, testing, and issue resolution.

Translate complex workflows involving inventory placement, capacity, cost, and delivery options into simple and intuitive customer experiences.
Work closely with UX designers and product managers to turn customer needs and product concepts into scalable technical solutions.

Deliver responsive, performant, secure, and accessible experiences across browsers, devices, marketplaces, and seller workflows.
Apply strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals to write simple, extensible, testable, and maintainable code.
Improve engineering quality through code reviews, automated testing, observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvements to development practices.
Investigate customer and operational issues across the full application stack and drive them to resolution.

DESCRIPTION
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Recruiting team is seeking a customer-focused Recruiter who is interested to work with a team of Builders and have a penchant for innovation.

You will successfully manage, prioritize and close multiple requisitions against a timeline and have experience setting benchmarks, metrics, and understand how to prioritize and meet or exceed target expectations to delight the customers. You will partner closely with hiring managers across multiple business lines to create customized hiring strategies for addressable talent pools and market conditions. In addition to end to end recruitment responsibilities across multiple hiring requests concurrently, you will work on both tactical and strategic projects to continuously innovate for our customers.

If you thrive in an innovative, fast-paced environment, desire to create amazing experience for candidates and internal clients and a demonstrated track record of success in recruiting, Amazon Web Services recruiting team could be the right place for you.

Key job responsibilities
Job Responsibilities :

- Skilled at partnering with hiring teams to build effective sourcing, assessment, and closing approaches with an ability to manage customer/partner expectations.
- Recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the long-range growth of the company, implementing any new processes and fine tuning standard processes for recruiting that fits within Amazon's mission to deliver the highest quality results to the customer.
- Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines and a formal tracking process.
- Participate in special projects/recruiting initiatives, including assessment of best practices in interviewing techniques, leveraging of internal sources of talent and identification of top performers for senior-level openings.
- Strong communication skills, organizational and negotiation skills, with a keen focus on delivering business results.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 4+ years of technical recruiting in high volume and high hiring bar environment experience
- Experience building candidate sourcing and closing strategies
- Experience creating, measuring and scaling workflow among candidates, hiring managers and the recruiting team

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience working with recruiting tools and systems, including resume databases, internet sourcing tools, and spreadsheets

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job_title: Full Lifecycle Recruiter I, WWAS TA
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
This is a contractual role.

Are you passionate about connecting talented people with meaningful careers? At Amazon, our recruiting team plays a critical role in shaping the future of the company by identifying and hiring exceptional talent across a wide range of roles. As a Full Lifecycle Recruiter I, you will manage the end-to-end recruiting process — from sourcing and engaging candidates to preparing them for interviews and closing offers. You will partner with hiring teams to understand their needs, build strong candidate pipelines, and deliver a positive experience for every person who interacts with Amazon during the hiring process.

This is a role for someone who is curious, resourceful, and motivated by the challenge of finding the right person for the right opportunity. You will use data-driven sourcing strategies, creative outreach methods, and your growing knowledge of Amazon's culture to attract qualified candidates efficiently. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy building relationships with both candidates and internal partners, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Source and engage candidates using internal and external tools, Boolean search logic, and multiple sourcing channels to build high-quality, unbiased candidate pipelines aligned with hiring team goals and service-level expectations.
- Conduct thorough pre-screens to assess candidate qualifications, compensation expectations, skill level, and availability, while clearly communicating the interview process and setting accurate expectations on leveling and compensation.
- Coach candidates on behavioral interviewing techniques and the overall interview process to ensure they are well-prepared, creating a consistently positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
- Partner with hiring managers and recruiting team members to calibrate candidate profiles, share pipeline insights, and surface blockers or process improvement opportunities that strengthen hiring effectiveness.
- Leverage recruiting data and reporting mechanisms to track candidate funnel quality, measure sourcing project outcomes, and maintain data integrity across all recruiting systems and documentation.

A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing your candidate pipeline, following up with prospects, and scheduling pre-screen calls. Throughout the day, you will connect with candidates to learn about their backgrounds, walk them through what to expect from Amazon's interview process, and help them put their best foot forward. You will also join intake meetings with hiring managers, collaborate with your recruiting team on sourcing strategies, and update candidate records to keep your data clean and actionable.

About the team
Our recruiting team is dedicated to delivering an outstanding hiring experience for candidates and internal partners alike. We work collaboratively to meet hiring goals while continuously improving our processes and tools. Whether you are refining a sourcing strategy or coaching a candidate through an offer, you will be part of a supportive team that values growth, creativity, and accountability. We are focused on building an inclusive hiring culture and are excited to welcome new team members who share that commitment.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Master's degree, or Bachelor's degree
- Experience building candidate sourcing and closing strategies
- 2+ years of technical recruiting in high volume and high hiring bar environment experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience working with recruiting tools and systems, including resume databases, internet sourcing tools, and spreadsheets

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Amazon is a US-based multinational electronic commerce company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Amazon.com started as an online bookstore, but soon diversified into many other categories, with a vision to be earth's most customer-centric company & to build a place where people can come to find and discover anything they might want to buy online.

Amazon's Finance Operations, Accounting & Analysis (FOAA) team is a fast-paced, team-focused, dynamic environment and delivering great experiences for our customers is top priority. FOAA is seeking a Finance Analyst to support our Accounting Onboarding team.

The Financial Analyst will partner with the Accounting Onboarding team (based in the US) to support various Amazon businesses for launching their products and services by automating their accounting and reconciliation processes. This is an exciting opportunity to join fast-paced businesses at Amazon. The successful candidate will be strategic, analytical, and have a demonstrated ability to support financial systems and architecture. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in cross-functional teams, and demonstrate strong leadership skills.

The candidate must have superior attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities. The position represents an exciting opportunity to be a part of an extremely dynamic and high -paced environment, support a global organization and work with accounting and business teams. The role offers significant opportunities for rapid growth and is a great place to learn about various businesses at Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
- Must have knowledge of an application’s functionality. They know what functionality is available in their system and how to configure it to work for business processes
- Help customers author and release accounting configurations using home grown business configuration management solutions.
- Troubleshoot integration issues by partnering with internal technical teams across the orgs.
- Work very closely with the technical teams across Amazon's lines of businesses to come up with innovative solutions that will accelerate the adoption of technology used for Financial Reporting and reconciliation.
- Work independently to manage projects and support Amazon's global businesses and development teams in the design and implementation of accounting systems.
- Provide project management update within and across business units to transition new processes and/or permanent solutions to support the Amazon accounting team.
- Coordinate with the global accounting teams to establish and maintain strong communication channels.
- Identify, implement, and adhere to best practices across all new project launches -Offering and receiving coaching, support, and guidance to the team.
- Supporting in User Acceptance Testing (UATs) in close co-ordination with business and accounting teams.
- Provide inputs for monthly and quarterly business reviews in a timely manner.
- Facilitate the business reviews with data analysis and follow through with business leaders on actionable items for improving business metrics over a period of time.
- Measuring and monitoring of metrics for new business initiatives.
- Present recommendations to senior management on strategic decisions, and planned future initiatives.
- Demonstrate appropriate understanding / working knowledge of accounting principles and internal controls, and apply them.
- Ensure appropriate financial policies, procedures, and internal controls are in place, documented, and operating as intended.
- Drive process improvements required to enhance controls.
- Actively participate in strategic initiatives and special projects when assigned or required.

A day in the life
Prioritization, Resource Planning and Stakeholder Management.

Gathering requirements from various Amazon businesses integrating with financial automation tools.

Collaborate with engineering teams to come up with optimal solutions for accounting automation.

Work on code review and config review process by following the guidelines.

Participate in UAT and guide internal customers with troubleshooting.

Work on deployments to production after acquiring UAT sign-off from stakeholders.

About the team
Amazon's Finance Operations, Accounting & Analysis (FOAA) team is a fast-paced, team-focused, dynamic environment and delivering great experiences for our customers is top priority. FOAA is seeking a Finance Analyst to support our Accounting Onboarding team.

- 2+ years of Accounts Receivable or Account Payable experience
- 2+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- Experience using data to influence business decisions

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- 2+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- Experience in TM1, Data Warehouse and SQL

DESCRIPTION
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About the Role:
As an GFOCC Tech at ADSIPL, you will get to maintain and operate the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure across a number of local and remote locations. The technicians are responsible for carrying out GFO infrastructure monitoring and servicing servers, network and telecommunication equipment remotely from a centralized location. This requires the ability to drive change while maintaining excellent communications.

Key job responsibilities
As an GFOCC Tech at ADSIPL, you will get to maintain and operate the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure across a number of local and remote locations. The technicians are responsible for carrying out GFO infrastructure monitoring and servicing servers, network and telecommunication equipment remotely from a centralized location. This requires the ability to drive change while maintaining excellent communications.

•Remote troubleshooting of GFO sites network and compute Infrastructure
•Remote triaging and repairing server & network hardware in coordination with on ground hands and eye support
•The role has 24X7 shift rotation.
•Coordinate in resolving data center facility issues
•Coordinating remote hands & eyes for any site issues
•Participating in small to mid-size site improvement projects
•Building relationships with remote facilities to ensure swift response times to events. - Improving Safety and Security operational processes
•Participate in team/service provider meetings for metric and performance analysis
•Assist senior techs in quality check of the new site and edge network scaling projects handed over to operations
•Guide vendor resources on AWS GFO standards, policies and guidelines providing remote hands and eye support

About You:
•You are someone who is highly autonomous, very detail oriented and possesses a very strong written & verbal communication skills. You are a high performing individual with a "can do" attitude.
•Supervise with Colocation operators performing servicing or preventive maintenance
•Assist in performing root cause analysis for operational issues
•Perform first level trouble-shooting for facility and rack level events
•You will have experience building relationships with internal and external teams/customers along with innovating effective solutions to resolve issues & problems as they arise.
•You will have previous hands on technical troubleshooting experience and a proven ability solving complex problems.
•Create CMs (Change Management Tasks) to enable changes and maintenance at sites
•You will be required to provide remote support required by our internal teams.
•Perform basic support concepts such as ticketing systems, root cause analysis, and task prioritization.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

job_title: Global Partner Development Manager, WW, GSI, Consulting Center of Excellence (CCOE)
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Global Partner Development Manager

About Opportunity
Would you like to be part of a team redefining how enterprises build and innovate with cloud and generative AI? Amazon Web Services is leading the next paradigm shift in computing — from generative AI with Amazon Bedrock to large-scale cloud transformation with AWS Transform — and is looking for world-class candidates to manage strategic AWS partnerships with leading Global System Integrators. Do you have the business acumen, technical curiosity, and partner ecosystem expertise to position AWS as the innovation platform of the future?
About the Role
As a Partner Development Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will have the exciting opportunity to deliver on strategy to build mind share and drive adoption of AWS’s cloud platform — including AI services (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, Amazon SageMaker), data and analytics (Amazon Redshift, AWS Glue, Amazon DataZone), application development (Amazon EKS, AWS Lambda, AWS App Studio), and cloud transformation offerings (AWS Transform, AWS Migration Hub, AWS Mainframe Modernization) — with one of AWS’s key Global System Integrator partners and their customers.
Your Impact
Your responsibilities will include driving executive and field relationships with a Global System Integrator. By establishing and growing business and technical relationships, and managing the day-to-day interactions with key accounts, you will be responsible for driving top-line revenue growth and overall end-customer adoption across the segments.
Role and Responsibilities
• Own and drive joint engagements between the Global System Integrator and AWS, managing co-sell and co-build motions across the partnership.
• Work with Geo-level and Country Partner management, and AWS account teams in a highly collaborative operating model to develop pipeline specific to the Global System Integrator.
• Serve as a key member of the Business Development team in defining and delivering the joint solution set and supporting collateral.
• Liaise with the Partner’s field sales organization, channels, and end customers to create and drive revenue opportunities for AWS.
• Define and execute a strategic business development plan spanning Generative AI (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, PartyRock), Data & Analytics (Amazon Redshift, Amazon DataZone, AWS Clean Rooms), Cloud Transformation (AWS Transform, AWS Migration Acceleration Program), and Industry Solutions — aligned with AWS’s next-generation go-to-market priorities.
• Drive joint Generative AI and Data/AI strategies leveraging Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, and Amazon Q — helping the GSI build practice capabilities, industry solutions, and customer proof-of-concepts on AWS’s AI stack.
• Partner with the GSI to drive large-scale cloud transformation programs using AWS Transform, AWS Mainframe Modernization, and the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), targeting enterprise workload migration at scale.
• Drive co-sell and co-build motions on AWS Marketplace and ISV Accelerate to unlock new revenue streams for both AWS and the partner.
• Execute the strategic business development plan while working with key internal stakeholders (e.g., service teams, legal, support, etc.).
• Identify specific customer segments and industry verticals to approach with a joint value proposition for using AWS.
• Enable partner’s practice development leveraging AWS Partner Central, AWS Skill Builder, and AWS Certification programs.
• Position AWS for internal use by the partner organization.
• Work closely with the Global System Integrator’s customer base to ensure they are successful using AWS, making sure they have the technical resources required.
• Ensure that AWS is the Global System Integrator’s preferred cloud computing platform across all product lines.
• Understand the technical requirements of the Global System Integrator and work closely with internal development teams to guide the direction of product offerings.
• Prepare and deliver business reviews to the senior management team.
• Support contract negotiations and serve as a liaison to the legal group.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate will possess both a business background that enables them to engage at the CXO level, as well as a sales background that enables them to easily interact with customers and account management/field reps. The candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions. Familiarity with AWS’s generative AI portfolio (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q) and cloud transformation methodologies (AWS Transform, MAP) is highly desirable.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- 5+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
- 5+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- MBA

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Amazon Freight India is seeking an experienced Linehaul Procurement Head to own the end-to-end procurement strategy for our linehaul transportation network across India. This is a high-impact leadership role where-in leader will own trucking/rail supply cost for countries one of the largest express parcel network. The incumbent will serve as the single-threaded leader for carrier sourcing, rate negotiation, vendor management, and capacity planning — ensuring Amazon’s linehaul network is cost-efficient, reliable, and scalable.
This role requires a seasoned procurement leader who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, navigate complex internal and external stakeholder landscapes, and drive measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in transportation procurement, a strong commercial orientation, and a proven track record of leading large teams and managing large-scale vendor relationships in a fast-paced environment.

Key job responsibilities
• Procurement Strategy: Define and execute the end-to-end linehaul procurement strategy across all lanes, modes, and contract types. Develop strategies aligned with network design, cost targets, and capacity requirements.
• Carrier Sourcing & Rate Negotiations: Lead large-scale carrier sourcing events (RFQs, reverse auctions, spot negotiations) and negotiate multi-year and seasonal contracts. Drive competitive rate structures while ensuring service quality and reliability.
• Team Leadership & Development: Build, lead, and mentor team of procurement professionals. Set clear goals, drive a high-performance culture, and invest in the career development of team members. Raise the bar on talent through structured hiring.
• Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary procurement interface for internal stakeholders (Operations, Finance, Legal, Network Planning) and external stakeholders (carriers, fleet owners, OEMs, industry bodies). Build trust and alignment across a complex stakeholder matrix.
• Cost Optimization & Should-Cost Modeling: Develop and maintain should-cost models incorporating fuel indices, toll structures, driver costs, fleet utilization, and market dynamics. Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives beyond rate negotiation (e.g., payload optimization, backhaul utilization, fleet mix optimization).
• Capacity Planning & Assurance: Partner with Operations and Network Planning to forecast capacity requirements. Build a resilient carrier base that can absorb demand variability during peak events (e.g., Prime Day, Diwali) and seasonal surges.
• Contract Governance & Compliance: Own the contract lifecycle — from drafting and negotiation through execution and renewal. Ensure all contracts are compliant with Amazon policies, Indian transportation regulations, and GST/E-way bill requirements.
• Market Intelligence: Maintain deep awareness of the Indian trucking and freight market — rate trends, diesel price movements, regulatory changes, competitive benchmarks, and emerging disruptors. Translate market insights into procurement strategies.
• Technology & Automation: Champion the adoption of procurement technology, automation, and data-driven decision-making. Partner with Tech teams to build tools for rate benchmarking, carrier scoring, and contract management. Leverage AI/GenAI tools to improve procurement workflows and negotiation outcomes.
• Executive Reporting & Communication: Author strategic procurement narratives, business reviews, and leadership updates. Present recommendations to senior leadership (Director+) and drive consensus on sourcing strategies.

About the team
The Linehaul Procurement team sits within Amazon India and is responsible for sourcing, contracting, and managing one of the largest transportation spend categories in the India supply chain. The team partners closely with Operations, Network Planning, Finance, Legal, and external carrier partners to ensure that Amazon’s middle-mile linehaul network delivers the right capacity at the right cost, every day.
We move thousands of loads daily across India’s highway network, working with a diverse ecosystem of fleet owners, transport aggregators, and OEM-backed carriers. Our mission is to build a world-class procurement function that drives cost leadership, operational resilience, and carrier partnership excellence — all at a scale that directly impacts Amazon’s ability to deliver for customers.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree, or MBA in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- 5+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
- Experience with high-level negotiation and successful internal and external relationship management
- 4+ years of business or financial analysis, product costing, procurement, or a quantitative role experience
- Experience working with cross-functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc.

- Knowledge of analytics & statistical tools such as SAS, PowerBI, SQL & ETL DW concepts

- Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
- Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
- Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities
🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations
- Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
- Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
- Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
- Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation
🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support
- Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
- Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
- Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

- Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager

- Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
- Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

- Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality

job_title: Innovation lab Lead, Fulfillment Centre Operations
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online. We hire the world's brightest minds, offering them an environment in which they can relentlessly improve the experience for customers. Innovation and creativity are built into the DNA of the company and are encouraged at all levels of employment. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity. We're making history and the good news is we've only just begun.

Summary: Amazon is a highly data-driven company that is passionate about its customers. As our operations network grows across Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres, automation is key to delivering orders on time, with quality, safely and at lower cost. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 is where new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, are piloted, tested and proven on a live floor before they scale across the network.

The Team Lead is a hands-on role at the centre of every pilot. They run the trials themselves, keep the pilot area safe, collect the data that proves or disproves each solution, and turn what works into standard work that other sites can adopt. This role suits someone with strong operations floor experience who is curious about technology, works well without direct supervision, and can get engineering, vendor and site teams moving toward the same outcome without having authority over them.

A day in the life
**Job Deliverables:**
- Pilot execution:
- Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan, including operating and testing the equipment yourself
- Set up pilot stations, material flow and test scenarios before each trial window
- Flag deviations from the test plan, and equipment or process failures, the same day they happen
- Safety in automation zones:
- Enforce the safety controls for the pilot area
- Carry out pre-trial safety checks and risk assessments for every new setup or process change
- Report and investigate near-misses and incidents in the pilot area
- Data and reporting:
- Collect physical pilot data (time studies, cycle times, downtime and fault logs, exception counts) according to the Business Analyst's data plan
- Check data accuracy at the end of each trial day and publish the daily pilot report
- Keep a live issue log (equipment faults, process gaps, user feedback) and follow up with Engineering, Controls and vendors until each item is closed
- Standard work and scale readiness:
- Draft and update SOPs and Standard Job Instructions (SJIs) for each pilot as the process changes
- Build training material and train site associates and teams on new equipment when a pilot moves to a live site
- Capture floor learnings for the deployment package that goes with a solution when it scales to other sites
- Conduct 4M and 5S audits on pilot workstations every day and keep the lab audit-ready for leadership and vendor visits
- Coordinate vendor and engineering teams on the floor during installation, trials and troubleshooting windows
- Work with site operations teams to schedule trials at their sites without disrupting their production
- Deep-dive on pilot metrics and propose clear actions and process improvements
- Stand in for the Ops Lead when needed

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with Excel

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- 1+ years of customer-facing environment, warehousing, logistics or manufacturing experience

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Corporate Infrastructure Services (CIS) builds and operates the systems that power Amazon's corporate offices globally — the networks, compute platforms, audio-visual systems, and operational tooling that every Amazonian depends on. Our Systems Engineering function owns the operational standards, fleet governance, observability, and engineering practices that keep this infrastructure reliable, secure, and cost-effective across a worldwide footprint.
We are looking for a Systems Engineer with a focus on fleet management and operational excellence. You will own the operational health, compliance, and lifecycle management of infrastructure fleets — ensuring that our infrastructure device estates are accurately inventoried, properly governed, and operating within defined standards. You will be the person who knows what we have, where it is, what state it's in, and what needs attention.
This role combines hands-on systems engineering with fleet-level operational thinking. You will troubleshoot difficult systems problems across hardware, software, networking, and cloud platforms. You will build automation that scales fleet operations — replacing manual processes with repeatable, reliable mechanisms. You will create and maintain the SOPs, runbooks, and documentation that enable consistent operations across a global footprint. You will identify patterns that affect fleet health, performance, and compliance, and drive improvements that deliver measurable results.
You will work autonomously, taking ownership of problems even when they cross domain boundaries. You will be proficient across multiple technology areas — operating systems, networking, compute hardware, cloud platforms, and monitoring tools. You will use AWS services (EC2, Lambda, Systems Manager, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, S3, Fleet Manager) and scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to build the automation and tooling that keeps fleet operations efficient and scalable.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the operational health and compliance of infrastructure fleets — maintaining accurate inventory, tracking lifecycle status, and ensuring fleet governance standards are met
• Troubleshoot and resolve difficult systems problems across hardware, software, networking, and operating environments, driving root cause resolution
• Build automation that scales fleet operations — device discovery, compliance scanning, firmware tracking, health monitoring, and lifecycle reporting
• Create, review, and improve SOPs, runbooks, and documentation to ensure consistent, repeatable operations across sites and regions
• Identify patterns that affect fleet performance, reliability, availability, or compliance, and deliver automation that addresses them at scale
• Drive operational excellence initiatives that demonstrate measurable improvements to fleet health, compliance posture, and operational efficiency
• Provide insight to engineers across domains (software, hardware, networking, security) on how their components interact to form a system
• Participate in on-call rotations, diagnosing and resolving operational issues across the infrastructure estate
• Mentor junior engineers, helping them understand systems architecture, operational practices, and fleet management disciplines
• Contribute to team design, scoping, and prioritisation discussions with informed operational and fleet perspective

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 4+ years of site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration experience
- 5+ years of Linux experience
- 5+ years of systems engineering experience
- Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
- Experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration
- Experience in any of the following: Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell or equivalent

- Knowledge of TCP/IP and networking protocols such as HTTP and DNS
- Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
- Experience working in 24/7 production environment
- Experience with service-oriented architecture and web services

* Maintain a positive and professional demeanor at all times

* Follow all site performance and behavior expectations as outlined by management.
* Demonstrate an appropriate sense of urgency for email response times and phone & chat service levels

* Escalate customer issues appropriately and in a timely manner
* Proactively communicate system & process issues

- Adequate communication skills.
- Proven ability to provide high quality customer service in a fast-changing environment by developing personalized responses for publisher questions.
- Must possess computer navigation skills, along with a basic understanding on how to use a website/web browser and the internet.

- Must be able to research, replicate, categorize, and document customer issues to identify & understand their problems.

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Managers – Investigations (RPE) set the direction and culture of their teams within a defined strategy by managing individual and team performance expectations and goals, providing individual coaching feedback sessions and weekly one-on-ones that focus on making Amazon's transportation platforms safer to transact, improving customer satisfaction, monitoring real-time service levels and schedule adherence, and serving as the point of contact for escalated investigation resolution of a supervisory nature.

The incumbent manages a team of L2–L3 Investigation Specialists who conduct risk reviews on drivers and accounts to protect Amazon from fraud, abuse, and account takeover, and who take appropriate actions based on processes, tools, and high-judgment decisions. This is a direct-supervisory role over individual contributors; the incumbent does not manage managers, and the number of reports is determined by their manager.

Operating in an area with established procedures and a predictable workflow, the incumbent provides tactical management, makes sound decisions within the team's defined strategy, and seeks direction and coaching from their manager as they continue to develop their management skills. In addition to achieving and exceeding the team's defined metrics through sustainable change or process improvement, she/he participates in project road-mapping activities, identifies trends in team performance, and recommends/implements change to constantly raise performance levels. The key to success in this role is the ability to understand the RPE group's vision and manage the team toward attaining it.

Performance Areas
Metrics — Consistently lead the team to meet and exceed service levels and targets in reducing risk-related losses and fraud, and maintain the performance and metrics of all team members (and hence the team) at expected levels. Audit work queues and SLA adherence, and report through Metrics, Service Level Agreements, and Key Performance Indicators. Contribute to forecasting accuracy and the staffing requirements needed to achieve SLAs, partnering with program and leadership stakeholders.

Process Improvement — Recommend improvements to tools and procedures for operational excellence, and deliver business impact through improvements to quality, productivity, or customer experience. Help identify and eliminate root causes of defects to drive efficiency in Amazon's transportation operations, escalating roadblocks and risks as appropriate. Work with peer technical teams to articulate and prioritize feature needs for investigation tool sets.

People Development — Develop the performance, careers, and skills of the investigator team through continuous closure of performance feedback loops. Specifically, the incumbent:

Attracts and hires bar-raising talent, working with their manager to get the necessary training and support to continuously raise the bar on candidates.
Guides the onboarding process for new hires using existing onboarding materials/plans that maximize rapid exposure and skill development.
Is able to explain Amazon's Leadership Principles.
Holds career-growth conversations to recognize strengths, provide constructive feedback on opportunity areas, and align work to areas of interest; helps employees define short- and mid-term development goals, identifies opportunities to meet them, and updates goals as priorities change.
Evaluates employees against the appropriate role guidelines/level expectations, participates in calibration activities with their manager, and is learning to seek performance information from multiple sources. Communicates in regular 1:1s how performance is evaluated and how each employee is performing.
Discusses promotion with leadership when an employee consistently demonstrates next-level performance in a next-level-scoped role.
Partners with their manager to identify, document, and clearly communicate needed performance changes (and timeframes) when employees are not meeting expectations, learning performance-management documentation best practices.
May be responsible for employee timesheets.
Creates and maintains an environment in which every employee feels valued, trusted, connected, and informed; displays empathy for team members' well-being and fosters harmony between work and personal commitments; and is learning to be an active listener who values team input and can change direction with new viewpoints.
Holds regular team meetings and 1:1s, effectively communicating team priorities and helping reports see how their work contributes to goals and customers.
Business Exposure — Use exposure to the team's technical and business areas, understanding of Amazon's transportation marketplace, and awareness of fraud, abuse, and account-takeover trends impacting the logistics industry to share ideas with management that positively influence the RPE group's vision.

Judgment and Discretion — Exercise discretion in tactical decision-making and problem-solving within defined procedures, identifying when a situation requires a deep dive versus a quick resolution, and making time-versus-resource trade-offs. Manage straightforward problems and escalate roadblocks and risks; routinely report to the management chain; and document decisions that involve partnering with internal stakeholders/teams when they have wider impact.

Communication
Clear and concise in verbal and written communication (e.g., narratives, WBR/MBR, meeting notes/agendas).
Able to manage meetings effectively and is learning to put the right people in the room; trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level (L7).
Learning to communicate across an increasing diversity of locales and roles.
Documents issues and conveys ideas and reasoning, following up with dialogue when needed.
Key Job Responsibilities
Manage a team of investigators (L2–L3 ICs)
Provide data analysis and conduct investigations (as needed)
Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL, and/or other data management systems) and perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed
Take appropriate action to identify and help minimize the risk posed by fraud or abuse patterns and trends
Help identify and eliminate root causes of defects to drive efficiency in Amazon's transportation operations
Understand the business impact of trends and make sound, data-based decisions
Systematically escalate problems or variances in information and data to the relevant owners and teams
Audit work queues and SLA adherence; make time-versus-resource trade-offs
Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed
Create a narrative outlining weekly findings and variances to goals, and present these findings in a review forum
Demonstrate solid business judgment, effectively communicate team goals, and drive a fast-paced organization to deliver results with a focused and pragmatic approach
Achieve operational excellence and drive process improvements
Develop employees and their skill sets to expand team capabilities
Manage and execute for defined metrics and quality; maintain clear metrics on investigation handling volumes, performance, and decision quality
Possess strong analytical abilities and judgment; use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and influence, show creativity and innovation, and drive projects with urgency
May be responsible for employee timesheets
Willing to work in rotational shifts

It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. The Middle Mile Transportation Technology organization, builds complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both time & cost of getting the packages delivered. Our services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers, owner operators and drivers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers. That said, this remains a fast growing business and our technical journey has only started. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, unique delivery models for products ranging from Amazon Fresh groceries, ultra-fast Prime Now deliveries of big-screen TV’s, increasingly complex transportation network, and growing number of shipments worldwide, we see a brand new opportunity to fundamentally change the way people get the stuff they need, and make a big impact by cutting billions of dollars of transportation costs from the ecosystem. Our mission is to build the most efficient and optimal transportation solution on the planet, using our technology and engineering muscle as our biggest advantage. DESCRIPTION
We are looking for an Applied Science Manager to build and lead Minerva's first Risk Science team in Bengaluru. This is a hands-on role: you will collaborate with scientists in the US to set the scientific bar and advance how we detect and respond to risk across KDP and Kindle Unlimited.

Key job responsibilities
- Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of applied scientists across levels, and set its practices for experimentation, evaluation, reviews, publishing, and patents.

- Push the quality of production risk models higher: set the standard for how model performance is measured, and lead the deep-dive science that turns model behavior into better detection.

- Develop new and improved detection models for fraud, abuse, copyright infringement, and harmful content, using NLP, computer vision, LLMs, and behavioral and graph-based modeling.

- Partner with engineering, product, policy, and investigation teams in the US and India to turn findings into fixes, and present options, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leaders.

- Work with the US science team to divide ownership clearly and share methods across Minerva.

About the team
Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) has empowered a new wave of self-motivated creators, tearing down barriers that once blocked writers from reaching readers. Minerva is the science and analytics organization for Amazon's Books business. We build systems for content understanding, author marketing and discovery, fraud and abuse prevention, and content risk, and we optimize manufacturing, fulfillment, and quality for Print On Demand (POD). We have mature areas and green-field opportunities, with engineering, business intelligence, and data engineering support across our areas. We are now building science teams in Bengaluru that work closely with our scientists in the US. Risk Science, a team within Minerva, keeps fraud, abuse, copyright infringement, and harmful content out of the Books catalog and programs such as Kindle Unlimited, using text, image, and behavioral data.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
