job_title: Sr. Electrical Design Engineer, APAC Data Center Design Engineering
job_description:
DESCRIPTION
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are seeking an Electrical Engineer to become part of a world class engineering team to lead the Electrical design of our Data Centers across our rapidly expanding Asia Pacific (APAC) portfolio.

We're looking for candidates that share our customer obsession by providing innovative solutions to enhance our market leading reliability. Technical leaders that can explain complex systems in clear and concise language. We contribute to our global body of knowledge and drive a cycle of continuous improvement at a global scale. We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience across the project lifecycle from concept design through construction, to commissioning and handover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the electrical engineering field. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As an electrical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, consultants and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence and a 25% travel will be expected as part of this role. Projects will be throughout the region and a degree of international travel and support will be necessary.

We are the leaders in our industry. We always strive to improve in every aspect of our business. Continuous improvement through Lean Engineering practices is fundamental to our business. As an engineer within our team you will spend a regular part of your time analyzing and improving every aspect of our value stream.

Key job responsibilities
The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for the following:
• Lead Data center electrical designs in collaboration with other disciplines to create a coordinated construction document set
• Participate in site selection reviews and work with local utilities to understand and define site utility requirements
• Critical Data Center equipment design including site-wide MV infrastructure, Generators, Uninterruptible Power Supplies, Switchgear, Transformers and Earthing
• Creation of designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements
• Work with regional vendors and manufacturers to specify the appropriate electrical equipment
• Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with IEC requirements, the various APAC wide design codes and other jurisdictional requirements
• Review and approval of equipment submittals and ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions
• Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases
• Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems
• Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and startup as needed

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader with deep IT consulting expertise, a proven track record in delivering complex technical programs across enterprise customers, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with limited guidance. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on incredibly high standards, and are passionate about mentoring others and scaling delivery best practices across teams.
You will lead matrixed teams of AWS consultants, partners, and customer resources across multiple work-streams simultaneously. You are expected to drive delivery excellence, maximize engagement value, manage risks proactively, and serve as a force multiplier for your peers and the broader organization. You will actively contribute to per-sales, build deep customer trust, and leverage AI/Gen AI to drive delivery innovation.

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
This Sr. Program Manager role will lead a program within Financial Integrity Trust (FIT), a team embedded within the Financial Risk Mitigation (FRM) organization. FIT is focused on financial integrity of engagement between seller and Amazon by ensuring a secure, transparent, and trustworthy financial relationship between Amazon and its sellers. It is a critical line of defense, stopping bad actors from profiting while ensuring a frictionless experience for SPs. We track “who” is profiting and “where” Amazon disburses funds, and own “when” disbursements occur. We ensure appropriate controls, verifications, and validations for both charge and disbursement instruments, reducing bad actors’ ability to scale fraud and ensure compliance. We also compute and withhold account-level disbursement reserves, govern payment speed, and recover funds from enforced sellers, preventing unpaid fees and misuse of funds.

In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. * Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.

* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.

* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
We are looking for a Tax Governance Risk Manager to join the TAC team and help build and run the governance function for Amazon's worldwide tax compliance programmes. This is a small, high-impact team where everyone contributes to shaping how governance works, not just executing it.

Your primary focus will be operational: making the Holistic Tax Governance Framework work in practice across 100+ tax regulations. You will run governance cadences, maintain control inventories, track risk indicators, produce audit-ready documentation, and hold teams accountable. You will also work closely with product and technology teams to ensure governance requirements are embedded in product design and that changes to tax products do not introduce compliance gaps.

You will work within Amazon's Three Lines of Defence (3LoD) model, ensuring 1st Line controls are documented, tested, and effective while coordinating with 2nd and 3rd Line partners on assurance activities.

Key job responsibilities
Governance Execution
- Provide programmatic support and maintain effective tracking mechanisms for various governance mechanisms across various Tax programs (weekly, monthly, quarterly), ensuring they stay on schedule and produce the required outputs.
- Maintain the control inventory across worldwide tax programmes. Ensure controls are documented, have clear owners, and link to regulatory requirements.
- Track completion of Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and escalate when teams miss deadlines or fall below the required standard.
- Monitor governance actions and remediation plans to deadline. Chase overdue items.
- Contribute to integrating bad actor detection and prevention into the governance lifecycle.

Product Governance
- Work with product and technology teams to ensure governance requirements are reflected in product design, business requirement documents (BRDs), and implementation plans.
- Review product changes and new tax programme launches from a governance perspective, ensuring compliance checkpoints are embedded from the outset.
- Track governance-related product risks and open items, coordinating with programme managers to drive resolution.

Control Monitoring and Risk Tracking
- Review and challenge Monitoring Control Indicators (MCIs), identify adverse trends, and flag them for review.
- Support periodic control testing: prepare test plans, gather evidence, document results, follow up on remediation.
- Review and track issue register items to ensure timely closure and ensuring deviations are promptly escalated through established protocols.

Reporting and Audit Readiness
- Produce governance reports, dashboards, and status updates for governance forums and senior leadership reviews.
- Maintain audit-ready documentation with complete, version-controlled evidence trails.
- Track key governance metrics: RCSA completion rates, control effectiveness, issue closure velocity, regulatory submission accuracy.
- Support audit preparation and response, coordinating with Internal Audit and external regulators as needed.

Cross-Functional Coordination
- Coordinate across Tax, Legal, Policy, Product, Technology, and Fraud Prevention teams to collect governance inputs and ensure deadlines are met.
- Act as the operational point of contact for governance queries from partner teams.
- Work across time zones with teams in the US, EU, Japan, and India.

A day in the life
Morning: you review the governance tracker. Two RCSAs are overdue. You send reminders and note the escalation path. Mid-morning: you join a working session with the Monitoring team to review MCI trends for a high-risk programme. One indicator is moving in the wrong direction. You document the finding and draft the agenda item for the next Quarterly Governance Review.
Afternoon: you review a BRD for a new tax regulation launch with the product team, checking that governance checkpoints and control requirements are baked in. You then update the control inventory, map the new controls, assign owners, and schedule the initial RCSA. Before close, you pull together the weekly governance status report and flag two items that need senior attention.
The rhythm is consistent: track, monitor, chase, document, escalate, report.

Your days will blend regulatory analysis, cross-functional delivery, and stakeholder coordination across multiple time zones. One morning you are reviewing control effectiveness with the 2nd Line of Defence; the afternoon you are in a working session with EU 3P Marketplace partners assessing the impact of a new VAT regulation on sellers. The next day you are preparing materials for a senior leadership review or troubleshooting a data integrity issue with tech partners in Seattle.

No two days are the same, but the constant is pace, impact, and global reach.

Amazon Flex Investigation and Offboarding (Flex I&O) is looking for a Team Manager to directly supervise a team of individual contributors across our investigations, quality assurance, and offboarding operations. In this role, the problem, strategy, and opportunity are already defined — your key responsibility is directing who does which tasks to meet daily goals while fostering a culture where team members feel valued, trusted, and connected.

• Hire and onboard bar-raising talent, ensuring new team members are effectively integrated and trained on Flex I&O processes, tools, and SOPs

In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.

You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!

Key job responsibilities
Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 10+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.

The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.

A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts

Amazon builds for everyone. TCI's Inclusive Experience charter exists to make sure the products and experiences we ship work for the full range of people who use them, so that no customer is left behind by how a product is designed. We move inclusivity upstream into how products are built, hold it as a bar products meet before they launch, and turn it into experiences customers can feel.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the programs that make this happen. You will own cross-functional initiatives that span product, engineering, design, and science teams. You will build and manage the plan, map dependencies across teams, surface risks early, and keep stakeholders aligned on a shared bar and timeline. You will operate at a technical level, understanding the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, and you will use that credibility to keep partner teams accountable to shared commitments. Above all, you will be the connective tissue that turns inclusivity from a set of individual commitments into experiences that ship on time and serve every customer.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and drive cross-functional programs that advance inclusive experiences across product, engineering, design, and science teams.
- Build the program plan: define scope, milestones, and success criteria, and translate charter goals into an executable roadmap with clear owners.
- Map and manage cross-team dependencies, identify risks and blockers early, and drive them to resolution before they affect delivery.
- Help embed the inclusivity bar into how products are planned and built, so it is met before launch rather than inspected for at the end.
- Keep stakeholders aligned through clear written status, updates, and decision documents.
- Operate at a technical level: understand the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and support sound decisions.
- Track the metrics that show whether inclusive experiences are reaching customers, and use them to inform prioritization.
- Keep partner teams accountable to shared commitments and timelines.

About the team
The Trust CX Innovation team drives advancements across Amazon Devices & Services (D&S) products. Our mission focuses on maintaining trust as the foundation while ensuring universal access as AI technology evolves. Our team develops essential privacy safeguards and accessibility features that serve millions of customers globally.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 2+ years of software development experience
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

DESCRIPTION
Amazon Flex Investigation and Offboarding (Flex I&O) is looking for a Training and Quality Manager to lead and develop our training and quality assurance functions. The Flex I&O team’s mission is to protect the Amazon Flex Brand and Customers by adjudicating Delivery Partner incidents that warrant offboarding after a single offense. This role is responsible for designing and delivering training programs, building and maintaining quality assurance frameworks, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to ensure the highest standards of performance, compliance, and operational readiness are maintained across all queues and geographies.
The ideal candidate is an experienced leader who is passionate about raising the quality and training bar, building scalable audit and learning frameworks, and coaching analysts and trainers to deliver consistent, data-driven insights that strengthen the Flex I&O operation. You will work closely with Program Managers, Team Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate audit findings and training needs into actionable improvements.

Key job responsibilities
• Serve as a subject matter expert across training and quality assurance for the Flex I&O team, providing guidance and support to specialists
• Design, develop, and deliver comprehensive training programs for new hires and existing team members, ensuring alignment with Flex I&O SOPs, policies, and standards
• Develop and maintain QA processes, methodologies, and best practices aligned with Flex I&O standards
• Establish and monitor quality metrics and KPIs to measure case accuracy, compliance trends, and training effectiveness across all queues and markets
• Conduct regular audits and calibration sessions to ensure consistent scoring, adherence to SOPs, translating findings into targeted training plans and process improvements
• Collaborate with Program Managers, Team Managers, and stakeholders to identify knowledge gaps, process changes, and training needs, and develop content to address them
• Manage personal workload and priorities to meet audit volume targets and training delivery schedules in a fast-paced environment
• Drive automation initiatives and implement tools to improve audit efficiency, training delivery, and reporting
• Report on quality metrics, training effectiveness, and trends to senior leadership, highlighting risk areas and recommending solutions
• Support onboarding by creating and maintaining onboarding materials, facilitating new-hire training sessions, and ensuring readiness assessments are completed before go-live

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- 1+ years of work experience
- Experience developing and delivering training programs with strong analytical skills to identify trends and drive data-informed decisions
- Experience developing or managing quality assurance programs, audit frameworks, or root cause analysis to drive improvements

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Familiarity with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma) or instructional design and e-learning platforms
- Bilingual (Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese, French)

DESCRIPTION
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.

A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

DESCRIPTION
Job Description for Transportation Representative – NOC
NOC Overview

NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.

A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representative should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience managing and or coordinating projects in a fast pace environment
- Experience in Excel with advanced proficiency (pivots, lookups, etc.)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Master's degree or equivalent in operations research, applied mathematics, theoretical computer science, or equivalent, or a Master's degree and experience working for Amazon or any Amazon subsidiary or affiliate

NOC (Network Operations Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
This role is based in Central Operations, which is a part of NOC. This team acts as a single point of contact for managing the route plans, scheduling and payments for the last mile stations for LATAM and AMET regions.

Purview of a Transportation Specialist
In this role, the candidate will work with business and operations team to solve customer escalations, analyze historic results, initiate programs – all in an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. Candidate will drive improvements to the visibility tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners. The successful candidate must show significant ownership on customer issues and proactively initiate SOPs and process changes as required. He/she will be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. He/she will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills, analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of customer to other stakeholders. He/she will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, and have excellent project-management skills Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Communication with internal customers (CS, MM, LM, FC, Trans Program, HR).
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create compelling positioning / messaging strategy and present complex information clearly and concisely.
High attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously with minimal supervision.
Strong analytical, mediation and problem resolution skills.
Demonstrated leadership with a bias towards action, supporting a culture of ownership and learning.
Skilled in collaborative management environment, clear formal and informal communication with members of the remote and local management teams.
Strong understanding of process improvement technique

Understand execution and daily production goals.

Review and update SOPs as required. At times assist with execution duties, training associates and verifying SOP compliance.

Handle incoming work requests within standard service level agreements (SLAs).

Provide direction utilizing independent judgment.

Conduct regular audits with associates for engagement and standard work adherence.

Assist in shift execution with shift managers.

Work a flexible schedule as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays.

- Experience with Excel
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics

TOC (Transportation Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, TOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving TOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, TOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Specialist
A Trans Ops Specialist at TOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.

A Trans Ops Specialist provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
· Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by TOC.
· Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data.
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.

RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations across RoW countries — Brazil, Mexico, AMET (Egypt, KSA, South Africa, UAE), Japan, India, and Australia.
The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational week-offs) to provide round-the-clock coverage across time zones.

Key job responsibilities
• Investigation & Case Management — Serve as a primary investigator conducting daily investigations across assigned geographies. Review cases from monitoring dashboards, determine root cause (process gaps, SOP non-compliance, or deviations), and document findings with supporting evidence within established SLA timelines.
• Deep-Dive Analysis & Root Cause Determination — Perform deep-dive analysis into raised cases by validating operational justifications. Distinguish between legitimate operational exceptions, process loopholes, and potential compliance deviations to ensure accurate case classification.
• Data Extraction & Monitoring — Extract and manage data from multiple internal portals and monitoring dashboards to support daily investigation operations. Maintain familiarity with data sources, system tools, and reporting platforms used across assigned geographies to ensure comprehensive case review.

• Continuous Improvement — Actively seek solutions through logical reasoning and identify trends to suggest process improvements. Provide feedback on detection accuracy and dashboard logic refinement to leadership for further evaluation and action.
• Confidentiality & Compliance — Uphold strict confidentiality standards for all sensitive information handled during investigations. Adhere to all Amazon policies, ethical guidelines, and compliance protocols governing risk management activities.

job_description:
DESCRIPTION
Want to help Earth’s most customer-centric company design, implement and monitor risk mitigation strategies to improve the customer experience and protect Amazon’s brand?

Amazon’s Transportation Risk & Compliance (TRC) team identifies and mitigates risk for last mile (LM) transportation programs in a rapidly growing and complex, global environment. To support the business, our primary mission is to perform independent and objective, risk-based assessments of Amazon business partners’ activities and related controls with the goal of improving operations, compliance, risk management, and overall success of the program. We provide Audit & Monitoring (A&M) support for high-risk transportation risk topics to drive compliance across the transportation programs and influence business controls
Amazon Quick Commerce (QC) program is experiencing rapid growth in Asia Pacific (APAC) & Middle East Türkiye and Africa (MEATR), operating various models across the region (e.g. in India, a hybrid model combining Third-Party (3P) On-the-Road (OTR) delivery partners and Amazon Flex; in MEATR via 1P and 3P programs). We are looking for an experienced Senior Risk Manager to join our APAC & MEATR TRC LM team, who can apply their knowledge of risk management and internal controls to a diverse set of transportation risk areas including compliance, process, technology, legal, finance, and program management, to lead risk assessment and A&M for QC program, specifically in IN and MEATR.
The successful candidate will propose innovative approaches and risk mitigation strategies throughout the business life cycle.

In this highly visible role, you will work closely with LM transportation business to evaluate risk and build A&M programs that support carrier partners in meeting legal and contractual obligations. You will be expected to apply risk and control concepts to new and existing business models, clearly and concisely communicate identified findings to senior leadership, and partner with cross-functions teams to design workflows in support of risk-reduction activities. You will set program objectives, assign appropriate metrics that measure success, and drive business changes that reduce risk. You will work closely with the regional legal, business, product, and operations teams on effective risk mitigation countermeasures to ensure continued safety and compliance for Amazon and our transportation partners. The role will require high-level strategic thinking to deep-dive analytical problem solving while thinking big. You must be comfortable dealing with ambiguity and enjoy working on different problems every day.

Key job responsibilities
• Independently conduct comprehensive Focused Risk Evaluations and Monitoring Needs Assessment of Amazon’s transportation programs (e.g. QC) and propose risk mitigation strategy.
• Assist stakeholders (e.g., risk partners and senior business leaders) with identifying and managing potential risks (e.g., regulatory, operational, or reputational) in their core processes that if left untreated could impact on the achievement of their strategic objectives.
• Identify areas where compliance monitoring required and design / develop a risk-based A&M program for 3P carrier compliance and lead execution.
• Manage the end-to-end execution A&M programs to determine if the transportation partners are compliant with contractual and regulatory requirements.
• Manage A&M findings, ensuring closure, or enforcement actions if they are not closed on time.
• Guide senior business leadership, resolve risk management concerns, implement mitigation strategies, and influence the product roadmap.
• Validate the business stakeholder’s risk control effectiveness and follow up their implementation status.
• Work closely with legal and public policy to identify the new regulations, understand emerging risk environment, and influence controls and compliance programs.
• Evaluate the effectiveness of the transportation program’s contract with 3rd party carriers and Amazon program policy to mitigate risks associated with transportation business.
• Advise the business on risk and compliance issues for new transportation initiatives, processes, risks and controls and building solutions despite ambiguity.
• Management and execution of cross-functional projects or programs including data gathering, analysis, communication of insights and recommendations.

- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines
- An online portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, Key Art, advertising or campaign work and the process behind it.
- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
- Strong skills in image composition, photo manipulation, retouching, typography, color and visual hierarchy.

DESCRIPTION
Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate’s route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions.

Recommending best practice, identifying and suggesting innovative solutions to improve efficiency and quality

Strong focus on efficiency, quality, reusability.

Drives design verification solutions across the business. Ensure culture of code reviews and postmortems.

Job Description: Reliability Engineering
About the Role
As a Reliability Engineering, you are a core technical expert within Cisco’s Quality Organization. You are responsible for the reliability execution across multiple product families (PFs), ensuring that our hardware meets rigorous quality standards from design through end-of-life. You will lead NPI engagements, manage cross-functional reliability tasks, and serve as the primary technical contact for product-level reliability issues. This role requires a strong technical leader who can drive project milestones, execute mitigation plans, and provide data-driven insights to engineering teams to ensure our networking infrastructure remains reliable and performant.
What You’ll Do
Project Reporting & Advocacy: Serve as the Reliability Lead for project-level reviews. Provide technical counsel to program managers and engineering leads regarding risk mitigation and the status of reliability deliverables.
Upfront Reliability Assessment: Manage materials and manufacturing reliability, product-level historical field reliability, and gap analysis to quantify risks for assigned products.
Reliability Plan Execution: Execute milestone-based reliability plans from planning through design and development, driving deliverables and tracking progress against product objectives.
Design-Phase Risk Analysis: Drive cross-functional FMEA and lead execution of derating analysis and schematic modeling, ensuring design parameters are validated prior to physical testing.
Validation & Demonstration: Lead RDT planning, execution, and failure analysis through product validation, driving root cause resolution before launch.
Launch & Field Performance: Drive early and ongoing field reliability monitoring, failure trending, and Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability (RAS) performance reporting; lead failure analysis for sustaining issues.
Sustaining Quality and Reliability Programs: Manage ORT, burn-in, and related programs to ensure sustained product quality and reliability in manufacturing and field.
Lessons Learned & Corrective Action: Participate in lessons learned and CLCA processes. Document findings to ensure insights are captured for current and future projects.
Technical Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and cross-functional peers. Promote a culture of data-backed decision-making.
Data Execution: Implement reliability data strategies by identifying data gaps in the factory and field and leveraging existing analytical methods to track reliability metrics.

job_description:
Meet the Team
Cisco is a global leader in networking and IT, dedicated to transforming how people connect, communicate, and collaborate. We have created an unrivalled company culture that is collaborative, empathetic, and provides employees with the autonomy to develop technology that is intuitive, secure, and simple for everyone to use.
Our Routing SD-WAN Group is at the forefront of innovation, delivering intelligent, secure, and scalable WAN edge solutions that empower enterprises to connect and protect their networks from the edge to the cloud. Within this group, the Routing Platform Software team builds industry-leading SD-WAN and edge routing platforms. We are reinventing the WAN with controller-based, intent-driven networking that delivers secure connectivity to users and devices across cloud, on-prem, and SaaS applications. In this role, you will develop and evolve the forwarding and platform software that powers our SD-WAN and edge routing solutions. Performance Debugging: Perform deep-dive analysis into performance bottlenecks at the kernel and hardware-abstraction layers, including the control plane.

Minimum Qualifications
8-12 years of industry experience with end-to-end software development in networking.
Experience across platforms, system software, kernel/user-space drivers, bootloaders, BIOS, and performance tuning spanning control-plane and data-plane.
Strong proficiency in C/C++ with a focus on systems programming and Linux environments.
Proven experience in developing device drivers, working with RTOS/Linux kernels, and understanding hardware-software interfaces.
Solid understanding of routing architectures and Layer 2 networking protocols (e.g., Ethernet, VLANs, STP).
Experience with bootloaders (ROMMON), hardware bring-up, and board support packages (BSP).
Demonstrated ability to debug complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, and software layers.
Experience with LAN/WAN communication interfaces and Layer 2/Layer 3 technologies.
Experience with AI/ML techniques and tools for development (e.g., code assistants, static analysis tools, test automation).

Preferred Qualifications
Knowledge of high-speed interfaces (PHY, MAC, MACSEC) and DPDK.
Platform/system expertise such as kernel bring-up, driver development, platform/network management software, and cloud networking.
Debugging experience with i2c, i2c trace analysers, and PCIe.
Knowledge of x86 or ARM assembly code, instruction sets, and ABIs.
Experience with debugging using hardware and software debuggers (e.g., GDB, Arium, BDI).

You will design sophisticated service-provider network topologies, develop comprehensive test strategies, automate large-scale subscriber and traffic scenarios, and validate the system under realistic customer workloads. Design and implement end-to-end cnBNG solution testing across Control Plane, User Plane,subscriber management, forwarding, platform infrastructure, and external network elements.

Hands-on expertise with Keysight IXIA and/or Spirent traffic-generation platforms, including
protocol emulation, subscriber emulation, traffic generation, scale testing, and performance analysis.
Strong Python programming and experience developing scalable test automation using pyATS/
Genie or equivalent frameworks.
Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD and continuous regression pipelines.
Strong IP networking fundamentals, including L2/L3 forwarding, IPv4/IPv6, routing, MPLS/L3VPN, and QoS. Knowledge of broadband/subscriber technologies and protocols including PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, and L2TP.
Experience configuring, validating, and solving IOS-XR or another carrier-grade network operating system.

Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit, built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys. Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of a 10-100-1000 journey, and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
About the Role
Meesho FS runs two lines of business: SME Lending, which offers Business Loans, and User Lending, which offers BNPL and Personal Loans (PL). 
User Lending is now our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey. We have 274Mn ATU, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale - our being a captive audience means both Growth and Risk are an outcome of underwriting, which is owned by the Risk team.
Herein also lies one of our biggest challenges: how do we assess the risk of borrowers without any credit history or income data? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
This person will be responsible for driving the analytics behind these questions for User Lending - creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and recommending policy decisions, across a well-established BNPL portfolio and a Personal Loans portfolio that is still scaling.
Your role will focus on:
Owning the risk for one or more segments of the portfolio while maintaining a healthy growth.
Analyzing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, SMS data, and other alternate data.
Creating policies, scorecards and models (Application Score, B-Score, Collection Scores) for BNPL and PL.
Designing experiments to test cohort behaviour, experimental policies, and new opportunities for growth.
Identifying pockets of risk within the portfolio that don't make sense, and identifying leading indicators / EWS.
Automating reporting and tracking of the portfolio at multiple levels - Ops performance measures, key performance indicators, and their drivers.
Refining credit policies based on data and creating new policies for unexplored segments, including building day-1 policies for Personal Loans as the product scales.
Configuring and testing rules in the real-time Business Rule Engine (BRE), and working with the Bureau Feature Store to define new underwriting features.


What you will do
Own and drive risk analytics initiatives across digital lending portfolios, including BNPL, Personal Loans, and other unsecured lending products.

Identify portfolio trends, diagnose emerging risks, and conduct deep-dive RCAs to understand key drivers of credit performance.

Partner closely with Business, Product, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to conceptualize and execute risk strategies and projects.

Evaluate existing and proposed credit policies and translate portfolio insights into actionable risk interventions.

Monitor key portfolio metrics including DPD buckets, roll rates, vintage curves, GNPA/NPA, collection efficiency, approval rates, losses, and portfolio yield.

Use data to assess the impact of risk policies and strategies on portfolio growth, credit quality, and profitability.

Perform data mining and analysis using SQL, Hive, Metabase, Python, and other relevant data tools.

Build and implement basic scorecards, analytical frameworks, and risk rules in Business Rules Engines (BRE).

Apply knowledge of PD, EAD, and LGD models to understand and evaluate Expected Credit Loss (ECL) and portfolio-level credit risk.

Present insights, recommendations, and risk perspectives clearly and compellingly to senior stakeholders, both verbally and in written form.

Work in a fast-paced environment, independently drive projects, and solve ambiguous business and risk problems using first-principles thinking.

Leverage AI tools in day-to-day analytics, problem-solving, and productivity workflows.

What you will need
3.5 years to 8 years of relevant experience is required.

Hands-on experience managing or analyzing portfolios in BNPL, Personal Loans, or other unsecured digital lending businesses.

Strong understanding of credit risk metrics and portfolio performance, including DPD buckets, roll rates, vintage curves, GNPA/NPA, collection efficiency, approval rates, losses, and portfolio yield.

Strong RCA, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.

Strong understanding of PD, EAD, and LGD modelling and their application in Expected Credit Loss (ECL).

Strong working knowledge of SQL and experience with data-mining tools/systems such as Hive, Metabase, or equivalent databases.

Hands-on experience with Python, including data wrangling, basic scorecard development, and implementing/coding risk rules in BRE.

Ability to work effectively with Business, Product, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate and influence risk decisions using data and structured thinking.

Experience working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment with ambiguity.

MBA, Engineering, or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work and problem-solving, relevant experience in Credit Risk, Risk Analytics, Credit Risk Policy, or Decision Science, preferably within digital lending.

About Valmo and the Data Science Team
Valmo is Meesho's own logistics arm, built to give sellers and customers cutting-edge, low-cost logistics and supply chain support. Supply Chain Network Optimization sits at the heart of the Valmo Data Science team: we design and plan the network that moves Valmo's shipments every day, from first-mile pickup through sort centres and line haul to last-mile delivery. We use OR, MILP, stochastic optimisation, simulation, ML and DL across network design, first/middle/last-mile optimisation, capacity planning and delivery promise, and we build for the long term, not just today's problems. This role is for someone ready to execute at speed, with a growth mindset, to build and scale these models.
 About the Role
As a Data Scientist 3(Operations Research), you will own a workstream within Valmo network design — not just a model. You will be accountable for the North Star Metric of that workstream (cost per shipment, end-to-end shipment speed, network capacity utilisation, on-time delivery, delivery promise), set its OR/ML roadmap, and mentor DS1s and DS2s in delivering it. You will take ambiguous, loosely-defined business problems, decide which ones are worth solving, formulate them mathematically, and ship optimization systems that run Valmo's network every day. Workstreams span network design, routing and scheduling across the first, middle and last mile.




What you will do
Own a workstream end to end: decide which problems are worth solving, set and drive its roadmap, and be accountable for the movement of its metrics.

Formulate complex, loosely defined business problems in network design, routing, scheduling, allocation and capacity planning as LP, MILP, MINLP or constraint programming models, with explicit assumptions.

Solve them at scale with decomposition (Benders, Lagrangian relaxation, column generation, branch-and-price), heuristics and metaheuristics (large neighbourhood search, ALNS, tabu search) and constraint programming, within real planning-time budgets.

Handle uncertainty with stochastic, robust and chance-constrained optimisation, and test decisions through simulation before they reach the ground.

Combine OR with ML and DL, such as demand and volume forecasting, ETA prediction and learned heuristics, wherever it improves the decision.

Write production-grade code and work with engineering to ship solvers and models into systems that run every day, with testing, monitoring and reproducible pipelines. Use AI coding agents as part of how you build, and verify the formulations, code and results they produce.

Mentor DS1s and DS2s on formulation, modelling craft and code quality; align the roadmap with product, engineering, operations and business; and explain trade-offs to senior leaders in decision terms.

About MAS
MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.
We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a technology company, not an AI BPO: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.
We've proven this model works — with marquee clients across consumer durables, auto, and D2C/marketplace businesses — and we're still early. We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This is a 0–1 business inside Meesho: no fixed playbook, high ownership, and the ground floor of how India's enterprises adopt AI-led operations.
About Role
This role is for a sales leader who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about selling AI-led offerings, and can operate at the intersection of AI, services, and enterprise problem-solving. You'll own the NCR region end-to-end — not just the last mile.
This is not a role where you wait for a handed-off, qualified deal. Our internal team owns top-of-funnel prospecting, but you're expected to get your hands dirty across the first and middle mile too — opening doors yourself when a target account needs it, staying close to discovery and org-mapping on your region's marquee deals, and not just parachuting in for the close. You're the face of MAS in North India: building trust with CXOs and BU heads, running the room in high-stakes conversations, owning the commercial close, and building the regional team and playbook as you go.
A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for the same reason: sellers never get deep enough into an account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. Closing that gap — real discovery, real stakeholder mapping, real champions inside the account — is as much a part of this role as the close itself.




What You Will Do
Own and drive deal closure for MAS's enterprise/mid-market book across NCR — from qualified conversation to signed contract.

Build and nurture senior relationships with CXOs, BU heads, and key decision-makers as the primary face of MAS in North India.

Personally lead high-stakes discovery, solutioning, and commercial negotiation on the region's flagship deals — and be willing to self-source, cold-call, or open a door directly when a priority account needs it, rather than waiting only on the central lead-gen team.

Own pricing strategy and structuring for the region — guaranteed-savings and outcome-based models, slab-based and pilot structures — and negotiate terms to closure while holding the line on our pricing floor rather than discounting to close.

Map client org structures to identify the true economic buyer, decision-makers, influencers, and blockers — and build internal champions who advocate for MAS when you're not in the room.

Mission and Vision 
 
Meesho is India’s fastest-growing internet commerce company, driven by the mission to democratize internet commerce for everyone (DICE). Technological Scale & Innovation
 
 At Meesho, technology is at the heart of our success. We have invested in a scalable infrastructure and innovative solutions to meet the demands of a vast user base and complex marketplace. Some key highlights include: 
 
Massive Scale: Our backend systems handle millions of orders per day from across India, reaching about 5% of all Indian households, all with near-zero downtime to date. Achieving this level of reliability and performance in a hyper-growth environment is a testament to our engineering excellence. 
 
 Marketplace Reach: Over 1.75 million sellers are registered on Meesho’s platform, supported by our state-of-the-art tech infrastructure and pan-India logistics network. This wide reach — covering virtually every serviceable pin code in the country — presents unique engineering challenges in areas like search, personalization, and payments at scale.
 
 Scalable Architecture: We continually innovate our architecture for growth.. Our quest to serve a billion Indian users has helped us evolve our technologies from a monolith to microservices to now a high scale federated architecture. This evolution allows us to build and deploy features rapidly while maintaining stability for a fast-growing user base. 
 
Cutting-edge Tech Stack: Our platform is built using modern, open-source technologies on the cloud while ensuring high efficiency. We strategically choose proven tools (for example, Java and Golang for services, Kafka for messaging, Dragonfly and Redis for caching, ScyllaDB, MySQL and Mongo for Data) and leverage GCP infrastructure to ensure high performance, reliability, and flexibility. By focusing on the right tools for the right problems, we innovate pragmatically rather than chasing every new tech hype, which helps us solve real-world problems effectively. 
 
Engineering Culture & Challenges 
 
Engineering at Meesho is driven by a bold and inclusive culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe that building great products goes hand-in-hand with building a great team. Key aspects of our engineering culture include: 
 
Long Term Thinking: We believe in thinking for tomorrow while building for today, this approach has helped us not only to handle and evolve for scale but also focus on extensibility and stability by investing in the platform
 
Lightspeed: We prioritize rapid iteration and delivery. Engineers are encouraged to ship fast and refine continuously, as we value in order to learn and adapt quickly. 
 
Continuous Improvement: We view failures and bugs as opportunities to improve. A blameless post-mortem culture ensures that mistakes become lessons, fostering an environment where learning from failure drives resilience and innovation.
 
 Ownership Mindset: Every engineer is empowered to act like an owner. We instill a “Founder’s Mindset,” encouraging engineers to take end-to-end ownership of projects and drive them with an entrepreneurial spirit. This means our teams proactively identify problems and champion solutions, just as a founder would for their own product. 
 
Engineering at Meesho is more than just writing code – it's about solving complex, impactful problems at an unprecedented scale. Our engineers tackle challenging use cases (from enabling real-time logistics across India to optimizing a vast product catalog for the next billion users), making a tangible impact on millions of entrepreneurs and customers. We maintain a
professional, yet passionate work environment where the drive to innovate is balanced with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

job_description:
About the Team
MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.
We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a technology company, not an AI BPO: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.
We've proven this model works — with marquee clients across consumer durables, auto, and D2C/marketplace businesses — and we're still early. We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This is a 0–1 business inside Meesho: no fixed playbook, high ownership, and the ground floor of how India's enterprises adopt AI-led operations.
About the Role
This role is for a GTM generalist who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about AI-led offerings, and wants to build the full range of enterprise sales skills — with an eye on growing into a closer and sales leader over time, or moving into Business/GTM Operations. Both are real paths from this seat.
You own the middle mile of the deal: the stretch between a qualified conversation and a close-ready opportunity. That means deep client discovery, mapping who really decides, understanding how a client's teams actually work today, and making sure the deal never goes cold on your watch — following up, keeping momentum, and setting up the closer to walk into the room fully briefed. Our central team owns top-of-funnel lead-gen, but this isn't a purely inbound or coordination role — you'll still make cold calls and run early client meetings yourself when a deal needs it.
A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for a simple reason: nobody on the deal ever gets deep enough into the account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. That's exactly the gap this role exists to close — the middle mile is where deals live or die.


 


What You Will Do
Own the middle mile of the sales cycle — from a client's first "yes, let's talk" through to a well-packaged, close-ready opportunity.

Run structured discovery conversations to understand a client's real pain points, current workflows, and AI-readiness.

Map client org structures — identify the true economic buyer, decision-makers, influencers, and blockers — and keep stakeholder engagement alive between senior-level touchpoints.

Help identify and nurture an internal champion for MAS within the account — someone advocating for us when we're not in the room.

Support structured, MEDDPICC-style account qualification alongside your closer, so every deal has an honest diagnosis of what's actually blocking it.

Make cold calls and run client meetings yourself where needed, working alongside (not just waiting on) the central lead-gen team.

Own the follow-up cadence after every client conversation — chasing next steps, addressing objections, and making sure momentum doesn't drop.

Build a working understanding of MAS's guaranteed-savings and outcome-based pricing models (per-minute, slab-based, pilot, risk-sharing) and contribute early pricing inputs on deals you're driving.

Brief and prep senior closers ahead of high-stakes conversations — sharp account context, clear stakeholder maps, clear next steps.

Bonus: build and iterate on client-specific product demos in partnership with Product/Tech.

Feed client and market insights back into the sales playbook and to Product, Tech, and Ops.

Bring structured, consultative thinking to every account rather than a transactional, task-based approach.

What you will need
4–7 years of experience in enterprise sales, GTM, business consulting, or client-facing analyst/BD roles, ideally with exposure to Indian mid-market/enterprise clients.

Strong discovery and analytical skills — able to quickly and accurately unpack a client's business problem and current workflow.

Comfort making cold calls and running early client meetings — this is not a purely inbound or coordination role.

A structured communicator — able to produce crisp meeting notes, account maps, and follow-up briefs.

Basic commercial acumen — able to understand and reason about pricing structures (you won't be expected to own pricing negotiations independently yet).

Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technology — you don't need to code, but you should "get it."

Exposure to (or curiosity about) structured account-qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC is a plus — we'll teach you the specifics.

High ownership and follow-through — comfortable chasing a deal over weeks or months without losing momentum.

Comfortable working in ambiguity, without established playbooks, in a 0–1/1–10 business environment.

Ambition to grow — either toward a full closing/sales-leadership role, or into Business/GTM Operations — over time.

Bonus: prior exposure to building or presenting product demos.

Evidence that you're genuinely top-tier talent — that might show up as academic pedigree (a strong record at a top institute) or as a professional track record (success at a recognizable brand, or a reputation for excellence in high-stakes client work). We care about the evidence of excellence, not which box it comes from.

Lead threat modeling and security reviews for new infrastructure and platform services, and drive the resulting requirements into production with platform engineering.

Kubernetes & Container Security: Harden GKE clusters and containerised workloads end to end: cluster configuration, RBAC, network policies, admission control and policy-as-code, workload identity, image provenance and registry controls, and runtime posture. Define the secure-by-default patterns that platform and product teams build on.

Identity & Zero Trust: Drive Meesho's zero-trust roadmap for infrastructure: least-privilege IAM at scale, elimination of long-lived credentials and static keys, just-in-time and break-glass access patterns, secrets management, and strong isolation between production and non-production environments.

Posture Management & Hardening: Own cloud security posture management using GCP-native tooling (Security Command Center) and complementary controls. Continuously find, prioritise, and burn down misconfigurations and attack paths across the estate, and convert recurring findings into preventive guardrails rather than tickets.

Infrastructure as Code & Pipeline Security: Embed security into how infrastructure ships: IaC scanning and policy enforcement (Terraform), CI/CD pipeline hardening, artifact and dependency integrity, and software supply-chain controls for infrastructure components.

SOC & Detection and Response (End-to-End Ownership): Own Meesho's SOC and detection & response function: run the SIEM and the managed detection (MxDR) partner relationship, own alert triage quality, escalation paths, and on-call, and ensure infrastructure telemetry (cloud audit logs, Kubernetes audit, network and identity signals) is onboarded and high-signal. Build and tune detections for cloud-native attack techniques, lead incident response as the senior technical responder, and drive post-incident fixes to architectural closure.

Security Automation: Design and build automation that multiplies a lean team: auto-remediation for common misconfigurations, access-review tooling, inventory and attack-surface mapping, and self-service security workflows for engineering teams.

Vulnerability & Patch Management: Own the vulnerability lifecycle for infrastructure: OS and image patching posture, container base-image management, exposure tracking, and remediation SLAs, with metrics that drive engineering prioritisation.

AI Infrastructure Security: Contribute to securing the infrastructure behind Meesho's AI workloads, including the AI gateway plane, model-access controls, and isolation and egress controls for agents and AI services running in production.

Mentorship & Security Partnership: Mentor the SE2 on the team, review their work, and raise the team's technical bar. Act as the infrastructure security subject-matter expert for platform, SRE, and DevOps teams, influencing decisions without direct authority.

Compliance Enablement: Translate control requirements from frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, the DPDP Act, and CERT-In directions (logging, retention, incident reporting) into pragmatic technical controls, and provide evidence from systems you own.

Experience: 5-7 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, cloud, or platform security, with a demonstrated track record of owning security outcomes end to end in a production cloud environment.

Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field is preferred.

Core Technical Depth:

Strong hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on GCP (IAM, organisation policy, VPC and VPC Service Controls, Cloud KMS, Security Command Center, audit logging); deep AWS or Azure experience with willingness to go deep on GCP also works.

Deep, practical Kubernetes security expertise (ideally GKE): RBAC, network policies, admission control, workload identity, image and registry security, and runtime threat detection.

Proven ability to lead threat modeling for complex distributed infrastructure and translate findings into controls that ship.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and with embedding security scanning and policy enforcement into CI/CD.

Strong scripting or programming ability (Python or Go preferred) and a bias toward building automation over running manual reviews.

Hands-on experience running detection and response: operating a SIEM (ideally with a managed SOC/MxDR partner), knowing what telemetry matters, writing high-signal detections, and leading infrastructure security incidents to closure.

Solid grounding in Linux, networking, and identity fundamentals (OAuth/OIDC, SAML, service identity).

General Skills & Acumen:

Sound judgment on risk prioritisation at scale: knowing which of a thousand findings actually matter and why.

Comfort operating in a lean team: self-directed, pragmatic about scope, and able to drive initiatives to closure across platform, SRE, and DevOps teams without direct authority.

Excellent communication skills, able to explain infrastructure risk to both engineers and leadership.

Ability and willingness to mentor an earlier-career security engineer.

Bonus Points

Relevant certifications such as CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, OSCP, or GCPN.

Experience with zero-trust architecture rollouts or large-scale IAM remediation programmes.

Experience operating or integrating with a SIEM/SOC, including detection-as-code practices.

Exposure to securing AI/LLM infrastructure (model gateways, agent isolation, egress controls) and software supply-chain security (SLSA, artifact signing).

Offensive security exposure: cloud-focused red teaming, attack-path analysis, or published research/CVEs.

From first-mile pickup to last-mile delivery and reverse logistics, ValMo powers millions of shipments every month for small businesses across the country.
Valmo (Meesho’s Logistics Arm) is building India’s largest and most efficient hyperlocal self-pickup network: Meesho Pickup Point. We are partnering with local Kiranas, pharmacies, and telecom shops to serve as highly dense, zero-effort pickup points for our prepaid customers.

As the SBDM, you will be the CEO of your "Mega Region," directly managing a large team of Business Development Managers (BDMs) to blanket your city with Meesho Pickup Points.

● Hire & Build: Recruit, train, and deploy high-performing BDMs across specific hyper-local zones (using data-driven geographic mapping).
